records.wp: Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure

records.lg: Ewoks: The Battle for Endor is a 1985 television film written and directed by brothers Jim and Ken Wheat from a story by George Lucas. It focuses on Cindel, a little girl who joins her friends Noa, Wicket and the other Ewoks in facing off against a band of Mar
To rescue Han, Leia and Chewbacca seek out Maz Kanata on Ord Mantell, and a brawl with bounty hunter Boushh hands Leia the perfect disguise.
After freeing Han from Jabba, the rebels strike the second Death Star while Luke confronts Vader and the Emperor, bringing his father back to the light.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

records.lg: Leia follows Wicket to two Ewoks held by stormtroopers and helps him spring a rope trap to free them; the grateful Ewoks reward her with a village dress.
After Endor, Leia stops the Ewoks from cooking captured stormtroopers and sends Han to Hera for rations, which cost him admitting the Ghost beats the Falcon.
Luke and Leia help Wicket and Kneesaa fend off a giant Gorax; Luke plays decoy while Leia borrows his lightsaber to spring the Ewoks' log trap.
Scrambling to stop stray TIE fighters heading for the Ewok village, Hera finds Chopper has brought two Ewoks along as gunners, and they prove crack shots.
Hired by a shadowy Imperial client, the Mandalorian hunts his quarry to a remote camp, finds the infant Grogu, and shoots IG-11 to save him.
Jawas strip the Razor Crest, and the Mandalorian must win the parts back with a mudhorn's egg, surviving the beast only because Grogu uses the Force.
The Mandalorian trades Grogu to the Client for beskar, then relents, storms the compound to take him back, and escapes the Guild's hunters with his tribe's help.
On Sorgan, the Mandalorian and Cara Dune train villagers to beat raiders and their AT-ST, but a hunter's arrival dashes his plan to leave Grogu there.
On Tatooine, the Mandalorian helps rookie hunter Toro Calican bring in assassin Fennec Shand, but Toro guns her down and turns on him, seizing Grogu.
Joining Ran's crew to spring a prisoner from a New Republic transport, the Mandalorian is double-crossed, turns the tables, and leaves them locked in the brig.
Promised peace by Greef Karga, the Mandalorian returns to Nevarro to take down the Client, but Moff Gideon's troops strike first, killing Kuiil and seizing Grogu.
IG-11 rescues Grogu and escorts the heroes to safety before sacrificing himself; Din Djarin downs Moff Gideon's fighter and vows to return Grogu to his kind.
Seeking other Mandalorians on Tatooine, Din finds Cobb Vanth wearing Boba Fett's armor and wins it by uniting townsfolk and Tuskens against a krayt dragon.
For a lead on other Mandalorians, Din ferries the Frog Lady and her eggs, but a crash on an ice world stirs a nest of giant spiders.
A New Republic envoy returns to Corvus offering Morgan Elsbeth a fair trial if she yields power; Elsbeth massacres the delegation and tightens her grip on Calodan.
On Trask, Din meets Bo-Katan, whose Mandalorians challenge his creed, and helps them raid an Imperial freighter in return for a lead on Ahsoka Tano.
On Nevarro, Din helps Cara and Greef blow up an Imperial base, uncovering Gideon's plans for Grogu's blood, while a spy plants a tracker on his ship.
On Corvus, Din finds Ahsoka Tano besieging Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth; Ahsoka learns the child's name, Grogu, but declines to train him and sends Din to Tython.
On Tython, Boba Fett arrives to reclaim his armor and joins Din against stormtroopers, but Gideon's Dark Troopers snatch Grogu and the Razor Crest is destroyed.
To locate Gideon, Din recruits ex-Imperial Migs Mayfeld for a raid on Morak, where Din unmasks to use an Imperial terminal and Mayfeld avenges a massacre.
Din's team storms Gideon's cruiser and Din wins the Darksaber, but Luke Skywalker saves them from the Dark Troopers, and Grogu leaves to train with him.

records.ti: Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land
records.lg: Now ruling Jabba's territory, Boba Fett survives an assassination attempt in Mos Espa, while bacta-tank dreams recall his escape from the Sarlacc and captivity among Tuskens.
records.wp: Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land

records.lg: Boba traces the assassins to Mos Espa's mayor and rebuffs the Hutt Twins, while flashbacks show him earning a Tusken tribe's trust by stopping a spice train.

records.ti: Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa
records.lg: Boba recruits a gang of modded youths, fends off Black Krrsantan, and learns the Pykes are behind his troubles; in flashback, his Tusken tribe is massacred.
records.wp: Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa

records.lg: Flashbacks show Boba saving a dying Fennec Shand and reclaiming his ship; now, he hires Krrsantan and asks Mos Espa's crime families to stand against the Pykes.
Din Djarin is cast out of his covert for having unmasked, and on Tatooine he test-flies a rebuilt Naboo starfighter before agreeing to fight for Boba.

records.ti: Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger
records.lg: While Luke trains Grogu and offers him a choice between Yoda's lightsaber and Din's beskar gift, Cad Bane guns down Cobb Vanth for the Pykes.
records.wp: Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger
records.sh: From the Desert Comes a Stranger

records.ti: Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor
records.lg: In the battle for Mos Espa, Grogu rejoins Din, Boba rides his rancor against the Pykes' droids and kills Cad Bane, and Fennec eliminates the syndicate's bosses.
records.wp: Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor

records.lg: To atone for unmasking, Din plans to bathe in Mandalore's Living Waters, fails to revive IG-11 as his guide, and seeks out a despondent Bo-Katan.
The Mandalorian and Grogu explore the ruins of a destroyed planet.
On Coruscant, former Imperials find amnesty in the New Republic.
Din Djarin returns to the hidden Mandalorian covert.
The people of Nevarro need protection from rampant pirate attacks.
The Mandalorian visits an opulent world.
Survivors come out of hiding.
The Mandalorian and his allies confront their enemies.
A valuable prisoner escapes New Republic custody; search for answers reunites two old friends.
Ahsoka and General Hera Syndulla travel to New Republic shipyards and make an unexpected discovery.
Hera tangles with New Republic politics while Ahsoka and Sabine Wren voyage to a distant planet.
Hera risks her career to help her friends while Ahsoka and Sabine confront enemies.
Ahsoka confronts her past, while Hera and her allies undertake a rescue mission.
The search for Grand Admiral Thrawn reaches beyond the limits of the galaxy.
Hera must answer to the New Republic while far, far away, a reunion takes place.

records.ti: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord
records.lg: The heroes race to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn's escape.
records.wp: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord
records.sh: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord

records.ti: This Could Be a Real Adventure
records.lg: Kids from an ordinary planet discover a surprising secret.
records.wp: This Could Be a Real Adventure

records.ti: Way, Way Out Past the Barrier
records.lg: A surprising first stop marks the beginning of an unexpected journey.
records.wp: Way, Way Out Past the Barrier

records.ti: Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem
records.lg: A mysterious stranger offers to help our heroes.
records.wp: Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem

records.ti: Can't Say I Remember No At Attin
records.lg: Our heroes face a surprise in a familiar setting.
records.wp: Can't Say I Remember No At Attin

records.ti: You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates
records.lg: A seemingly pleasant world will test our heroes like no other.
records.wp: You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates

records.lg: Relationships fray under the pressures of a difficult journey.

records.ti: We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble
records.lg: Our heroes have never felt further from home.
records.wp: We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble

records.lg: A journey filled with adventure comes to a surprising end.
Sent to fetch Jabba's son Rotta, Din Djarin learns the Hutt Twins want their nephew dead and shields him. When they strike back, Grogu must save his father.
records.wp: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

records.lg: X-wing pilot Kazuda Xiono is recruited for the Resistance, but finds himself in over his head when Poe Dameron assigns him to a remote fueling station to spy on the First Order. Then, after Kaz boasts about being the best pilot around, he is forced to compete in a dangerous sky race.
Kaz and BB-8 uncover information on an imminent pirate attack and must find a way to stop it.
Kaz befriends a sky racer named Rucklin who pressures him to take some rare and dangerous hyperfuel hidden in Yeager's office.
The First Order arrives at the platform for mysterious reasons and Kaz and BB-8 are determined to sneak into the tower to find out what they want.
In need of credits to fix a broken part, Kaz looks to recover two missing children and claim a sizable bounty.
Kaz and Poe Dameron investigate a distress signal, and find something much bigger than they anticipated.
BB-8 goes on an adventure and tries to find Kaz!
With his spy in place, pirate leader Kragan Gorr seizes the opportunity to strike at the Colossus.
When hotshot racer Marcus Speedstar arrives on the Colossus, Yeager is confronted by a painful past he's kept hidden.
While Captain Doza meets with the First Order, Torra, Kaz, and BB-8 sneak around on their own secret mission.
What begins as a simple recon mission of an abandoned First Order base becomes much more complicated…once Captain Phasma arrives.
When Neeku adopts a strange sea creature as a pet, he gets way more than he bargained for. Meanwhile, Kaz and Synara encounter something monstrous in the Castilon oceans…
In exchange for parts, Kaz agrees to watch Flix and Orka's shop. But things take a deadly turn when a mysterious customer arrives.
Kaz and Bucket's game goes awry as they try and impress their pals.
Neeku's food gets away from him in the marketplace!
When Bucket loses his helmet, he'll do anything to get it back!
It's a bad idea to try and rob Flix & Orka!
Flix & Orka try and open a chest with disastrous results!
There's a reason why Cantinas don't serve droids!
Flix & Orka try and fix Hype's broken, angry droid!
The Aces race to compete for Hype's top spot!
Kaz and Torra try and test the Fireball's thrusters!
The Aces band together to stop a crashing ship!
Kaz gets in trouble when he tries to take care of Buggles!
When the pirates launch an unsettling mission on the Colossus, Synara's loyalty and allegiances are put to the test.
As the First Order tightens its grip on the Colossus, the pressure mounts for Kaz and Synara.
After Kel and Eila, fugitives from the First Order, have a run-in with a stormtrooper, Kaz seizes the opportunity to uncover more details about the growing movement.
Rey discovers a stubborn, unmoving Happabore sitting on the ship she's meant to tow back.

While scavenging inside a Star Destroyer, Rey is cornered by Teedo who is on the hunt for a valuable part. Rey tries to warn Teedo the removal of the part will trigger the vessel's collapse, but he does it anyway and she must help them both escape after Teedo is knocked out by falling debris
Poe and Kaz investigate a location in the Unknown Regions that might be central to the First Order's plot.
As the First Order cracks down on dissent and issues unsettling new demands, Kaz and Torra take action.
Now on the radar of the First Order, Kaz and Yeager must act quickly to save the Colossus — and their friends.
Scavenger Rey and defector Finn help the Resistance protect a map to the vanished Luke Skywalker, destroying Starkiller Base after Kylo Ren kills his father, Han Solo.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

records.lg: Rey fends off a creature that wants to devour her new friend, BB-8.
Rey and BB-8 take off on a speeder to flee scavenger thugs who want to steal BB-8.
Chewie and Rey use their mechanical skill to find a tracker bomb on the Millennium Falcon.
Kaz hatches a plan to rescue his friends, while the First Order's quest for power takes a dark turn.
Following the destruction of Hosnian Prime and other systems, Kaz and Yeager lead the forces of the Colossus into battle with the First Order.

Following their battle with the First Order, Kaz and his friends hope to reach the Resistance base on D'Qar. But the Colossus has suffered damage, and there may be other threats lurking in the shadows...
In a dangerous snowspeeder chase across Starkiller Base, Rey and Finn work together to escape pursuing snowtroopers.
The First Order hunts the fleeing Resistance while Rey seeks a disillusioned Luke and bonds with Kylo Ren, who kills Snoke, before Luke's last stand saves the survivors.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

records.lg: As Rey struggles to force lift stones, a curious porg snatches her lightsaber! Rey gives chase and force lifts the porg before it can dive into the water with her saber. Rey thanks the porg for the unexpected help in her training.

Chewie is exasperated when a pair of porgs tears blue wiring out of the Falcon. Further investigation with help from R2-D2 reveals that the porgs are looking for hard-to-find blue moss for their nest—if only Chewie can get it for them.

On their approach to Canto Bight, Finn and Rose encounter a pod of creatures in the atmosphere. When a tentacle hits the shuttle and shorts out BB-8, Finn and Rose must work together to fix BB-8 and land the shuttle safely.
The Colossus, low on hyperfuel, arrives at D'Qar only to find the aftermath of a deadly battle — but Kaz looks to seize an opportunity.
With the Aces in need of combat training, Yeager becomes their new squad leader and Kaz joins the team. Meanwhile, Tam begins her own pilot exercises with the First Order.
As the Colossus runs dangerously low on food, Kaz and Torra look to catch the massive jakoosk creature in a last-ditch attempt to feed the ship's citizenry.
Kaz and Synara investigate a distress signal and find a survivor of a First Order attack. But is she really who she claims to be?
Kaz and his friends head to Flix's homeworld in search of fuel. But has deep-core drilling awoken a fabled creature?
On a simple supply run, Kaz and his friends discover something ancient and unexpected.
The First Order captures a Resistance pilot with a connection to Captain Doza and Torra.
The Colossus visits a casino for some racing that will hopefully bring a big payday to the platform. But the owner's ships may not be so easy to defeat.
After a pirate places a curse on Kaz, matters become worse when the Colossus enters Guavian Death Space.
When Tam is sent to a First Order refueling station, some unexpected guests test the limits of her loyalty.
Kaz leads a strike team to investigate a mysterious Resistance distress signal.
Kaz and Norath hatch a plan to rescue their friends, but bounty hunter Ax Tagrin looks to capture them once and for all.
Pirate leader Kragan Gorr hatches a plot to take over the Colossus – with super battle droids from the Clone Wars!
The Colossus arrives at a beautiful planet that Captain Doza hopes will be its new home. But the world's inhabitants may not be so welcoming...
Kaz decides to fully join the Resistance and fight the First Order...but they may have found him first.
Venisa Doza's fighter squadron and the Aces launch a dangerous mission to escort Resistance recruits to safety.
Kaz and Yeager attempt to rescue Tam from the First Order while trying to evade capture on a Star Destroyer. Meanwhile, the Colossus is in trouble and faces an impossible choice.
Palpatine returns, and Rey, learning she is his granddaughter, confronts him on Exegol with a redeemed Ben Solo as the galaxy rallies to defeat his Sith fleet.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Universe and galaxy take shape
events.note: Canon gives no age for the universe or the galaxy; the anchor is a placeholder that only keeps the earliest events in order.
events.summary: Eons before any recorded history, the universe begins to form, and the galaxy gathers around a giant black hole at its heart, the region later called the Galactic Centre.
sources: Smuggler's Run: A Han Solo & Chewbacca Adventure

events.title: Midi-chlorians arise on the Wellspring of Life
events.note: Undated in canon. Placeholder anchor after the galaxy's formation, following the order of Wookieepedia's prehistory list.
events.summary: Midi-chlorians, microscopic life forms dwelling in every living thing, originate on the Wellspring of Life, an uncharted world in the Deep Core. They bind living beings to the Force and let them sense what it wills.

events.title: The Ones make their home on Mortis
events.note: Undated; the Father is said to have kept the balance 'for eons'. Placeholder anchor that follows Wookieepedia's list order.
events.summary: Three beings of immense Force power, a Father with his Son and Daughter, come to dwell on Mortis, a planet-like realm within the Force. The Son embodies the dark side, the Daughter the light; the Father holds them in balance.

events.title: Kyber crystals form within Ilum
events.yText: billions of years before the Imperial Era
events.note: The source says only 'billions of years' before the Imperial Era; anchored at two billion as a floor.
events.summary: Over billions of years, minerals seep into the rock of the planet Ilum, seeding its caverns with rare Force-attuned kyber crystals that will one day give Jedi lightsabers their blades.
events.tText: billions of years before the Imperial Era

events.title: Far-galaxy travelers build the Seatos reflex point
events.note: Undated. Wookieepedia's timeline lists it among undated ancient events ahead of its 100,000 BBY entries, so it is anchored there; it could be far older or younger.
events.summary: Visitors from another galaxy raise a reflex point in a henge on Seatos, charting the way home to Peridea. These people come to be called the Dathomiri; their Nightsister descendants later keep a star map to Peridea on Arcana.

events.title: Coruscant's first city levels rise
events.summary: On Coruscant, in the Core, builders lay the planet's earliest city tiers, beginning a building project that will one day cover the entire world in a single sprawling city.
sources: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 26

events.title: The hyperdrive is invented
events.note: Undated. Wookieepedia's timeline puts it after the 57,000 BBY settlement of Utapau and before the c. 30,000 BBY Devaronian explorers, who built their own drives; anchored at that later bound.
events.summary: After ages of slow generation ships and sleeper ships, scientists studying the purrgil, space-dwelling creatures that leap between star systems, work out how to reach hyperspace. The resulting hyperdrive opens the galaxy to fast interstellar travel.

events.title: The Jedi Order is founded on Ahch-To
events.summary: At a Force nexus on remote Ahch-To, the figure later revered as the Prime Jedi establishes the Jedi Order to keep peace and justice, raising the first Jedi Temple; a village grows on the island soon after. The Dai Bendu are among its forerunners.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: A Jedi scout discovers Ilum
events.summary: Shortly after the Order's founding, a Jedi scout reaches the frozen world of Ilum by steering through hyperspace with the Force, finding a planet that will become central to Jedi tradition.

events.title: The droid Huyang is activated
events.summary: The droid Huyang is built and begins serving the Jedi. For thousands of years he will guide younglings as they assemble their first lightsabers, and he will outlast the Order itself.

events.title: The Galactic Republic is founded
events.summary: Twenty-two Core Worlds, among them Alderaan, band together as the Core Founders and form the Galactic Republic, a union that will spread its rule across the galaxy over the coming millennia.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm
events.conflict: Wookieepedia's main timeline, citing Star Wars: Timelines and The Rising Storm, dates the founding to c. 25,000 BBY; its Galactic Republic article instead gives a window from c. 25,000 BBY (The Star Wars Book) to c. 20,000 BBY (Star Wars: Timelines).

events.title: Great trade routes open the galaxy
events.summary: During the Expansionist Period after the Republic's founding, the Perlemian Trade Route, the Corellian Run and the Corellian Trade Spine are laid out, major hyperlanes binding the Core Worlds to distant regions.
sources: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 29

events.title: The Ordu Aspectu fall at Garn
events.summary: The Ordu Aspectu, a Jedi splinter sect led by Rur that sought immortality, makes peace with the Jedi after the Entruvia Conflict. When Jedi inspectors arrive, an AI copy of Rur turns the citadel's droids on everyone; Rur dies stopping it.

events.title: Ossus becomes the Jedi cultural heart
events.note: Nexus of Power says Ossus had been the Jedi's cultural center for 12,000 years before the Imperial Era.
events.summary: According to Jedi tradition, the world Ossus becomes the Order's cultural center, a place of learning that nearly every Jedi is expected to visit on pilgrimage.

events.title: Stybla unification forges the Chiss Ascendancy
events.summary: Far out in the Unknown Regions, the Stybla family unites the Chiss Great Families and becomes the first Ruling Family, founding the Chiss Ascendancy, a secretive state whose code forbids its forces from striking first.

events.title: The Hundred-Year Darkness births the Sith
events.note: Star Wars: Timelines dates the schism to about 5000 BBY; Wookieepedia's main timeline leaves it undated.
events.summary: A rogue Jedi who believes true power lies in the dark side breaks from the Order with his followers. After the schism called the Hundred-Year Darkness they are driven into exile on Korriban, later Moraband, and become the Sith.

events.title: The Sith Wars
events.summary: For roughly four thousand years, successive Sith empires battle the Republic and its Jedi defenders, wielding slave armies and kyber-powered superweapons; even the distant Chiss are drawn in. The wars end only with the Sith's apparent destruction.

events.title: Naga Sadow's Great Hyperspace War
events.note: Known through the Qel-Droma Epics, an in-universe account of uncertain reliability.
events.summary: In the Qel-Droma Epics, a semi-legendary chronicle, Naga Sadow, a Sith Lord, launches the Great Hyperspace War against the Republic and its Jedi, beginning with an invasion of the Deep Core world Empress Teta. The Sith are beaten back.

events.title: The Sith seize Coruscant and raise a shrine
events.note: Tarkin has the shrine abandoned for close to 5,000 years by 14 BBY; Wookieepedia's battle article allows any date from c. 5000 to 1032 BBY.
events.summary: Back from exile, the Sith make war on the Republic and capture its capital, Coruscant, building a black shrine over a Force vergence on a sacred mountain. The Jedi eventually retake the world and raze the shrine, though a hidden part of it endures.

events.title: The Great Jedi Library rises on Ossus
events.note: Dated via the Qel-Droma Epics as retold in Nexus of Power.
events.summary: The Qel-Droma Epics credit Jedi Master Odan-Urr with overseeing the founding of the Great Jedi Library of Ossus, which for close to a millennium houses the Order's gathered knowledge.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: The Massassi build Yavin 4's Great Temple
events.summary: On the jungle moon Yavin 4, Massassi warriors, reportedly under Naga Sadow's command, raise the stone Great Temple. Some five millennia later the Rebel Alliance will hide its main base inside it.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 23

events.title: The Starflash saves Csilla at terrible cost
events.summary: Cornered at their homeworld by an unnamed enemy, the Chiss fire the Starflash, a one-shot alien superweapon of great age that consumes its twenty operators. The enemy fleet is annihilated, but the blast cools Csilla's sun and freezes the planet's surface.

events.title: Grizmallt refugees settle Naboo
events.summary: Humans escaping Grizmallt's civil war make a new home on Naboo, a Mid Rim world their explorers found nearly a century earlier. They fight the native Gungans for decades before the two peoples agree to keep apart.

events.title: Naboo's Time of Suffering
events.summary: Calling themselves the Naboo, the planet's human settlers split into rival city-states that war with one another for over three thousand years. Meanwhile the Gungan tribes unite under Boss Gallo and begin building Otoh Gunga.

events.title: The Crusade of Krath
events.note: Known only from the Qel-Droma Epics as retold in Nexus of Power.
events.summary: The Qel-Droma Epics tell of the Crusade of Krath, in which a new Sith Empire cuts down thousands of Jedi, a war that ends only with the redemption of the fallen Jedi Ulic Qel-Droma.

events.title: The Cron Supernova devastates Ossus
events.summary: The Qel-Droma Epics say that Naga Sadow, a Sith Lord, sets off a supernova in the Cron Cluster, destroying the cluster and devastating Ossus, the Jedi world that houses the Great Jedi Library.

events.title: The Great Scourge of Malachor
events.note: Wookieepedia's article gives only a c. 5000-1032 BBY window; its timeline lists the battle after the c. 3966 BBY Sith accounts of Malachor's kyber weaponry, so it is anchored there.
events.summary: Jedi Knights assault Malachor's Sith temple, a combined battle station and superweapon; its activation turns everyone in the battle, Jedi and Sith alike, to stone. The Jedi then forbid travel to Malachor and purge it from their archives.

events.title: Freia Kallea blazes the Hydian Way
events.summary: Freia Kallea joins a string of shorter routes into the Hydian Way, a super-hyperroute that lets merchants and privateers cross the galaxy from end to end.
sources: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 29

events.title: The Drengir ally with the Sith
events.summary: The Drengir, sentient carnivorous plants joined in a hive mind, ally with the Sith. The Sith later turn on them, imprisoning their Great Progenitor aboard an abandoned Amaxine space station and leaving the Drengir dormant for millennia.

events.title: The Temple of the Kyber rises on Jedha
events.yText: thousands of years before the Clone Wars
events.note: Undated; 'thousands of years' before the Clone Wars means no later than about 2022 BBY, used as the anchor.
events.summary: In the Holy City on Jedha, a frigid desert moon, builders raise the Temple of the Kyber. Sacred to the Church of the Force and kept by the Guardians of the Whills, it will stand until the Death Star's first test shot.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide
events.tText: thousands of years before the Clone Wars

events.title: Jedi break the Zygerrian Slave Empire
events.yText: thousands of years before the Clone Wars
events.note: Undated; begun 'thousands of years' before the Clone Wars, so anchored no later than about 2022 BBY.
events.summary: After the Republic outlaws slavery, the Jedi Order fights the Zygerrian Slave Empire and dismantles its operations, shattering a regime that had sold slave labor across the galaxy for thousands of years and leaving Zygerrians with a lasting hatred of the Jedi.
events.tText: thousands of years before the Clone Wars

events.title: An old Jedi distress code falls silent
events.note: In Overlords the code is said to have gone unused for over 2,000 years before the Clone Wars.
events.summary: A Jedi distress code falls out of use. More than two thousand years later the Ones of Mortis will broadcast it to lure Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi into their realm.

events.title: Darth Momin, the Sith sculptor
events.summary: Freed from prison and trained by Darth Shaa, the artist Momin later murders his teacher and roams the galaxy designing dark weapons. Two Jedi slay him as he levels a city with a superweapon, but his spirit lives on inside his mask.

events.title: Tarre Vizsla forges the Darksaber
events.summary: Tarre Vizsla, the Order's first Mandalorian Jedi, builds the Darksaber, a singular lightsaber with a black blade. After his death the Temple keeps it, yet it becomes the emblem of House Vizsla and of rule over Mandalore.
events.conflict: Wookieepedia's Darksaber article and main timeline read Star Wars: Timelines' c. 1050 BBY as the year the blade was made, while its Tarre Vizsla article reads the same date as when he entered the Order as a child.

events.title: The Mandalorian-Jedi War lays waste to Mandalore
events.yText: during the fall of the Old Republic (before 1032 BBY)
events.note: The war spans ages, back to legendary crusades; Wookieepedia's timeline places its final stage, which ruined Mandalore, in the fall of the Old Republic that ended in 1032 BBY. Anchor is approximate.
events.summary: Mandalorian warriors, whose armor and weapons grew out of their clashes with Force-wielders, fight the Jedi in a long series of wars, from legendary crusades to a final conflict that leaves Mandalore's surface livable only inside sealed domed cities.
events.tText: during the fall of the Old Republic (before 1032 BBY)

events.title: House Vizsla steals the Darksaber
events.note: Dated only as 'sometime after 1050 BBY' during the fall of the Old Republic, which closed in 1032 BBY.
events.summary: As the Old Republic collapses, Mandalorians of House Vizsla raid the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and carry off the Darksaber. Their descendants will cut down many Jedi with it and use it to rule Mandalore.

events.title: Lady Corvax's ritual scorches Mustafar
events.note: Vader Immortal says the Corvaxes lived before the Galactic Republic; Wookieepedia takes that to mean before 1032 BBY, so this is a latest-possible anchor.
events.summary: When her husband is killed in an attack on lush Mustafar, Lady Corvax steals the Mustafarians' sacred Bright Star for a ritual to revive him. It fails; the crystal's energy shoves the planet onto a new orbit, leaving a volcanic wasteland that later attracts Sith.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: The Sith are defeated at Ruusan
events.summary: Weakened by infighting, the Sith's Brotherhood of Darkness is crushed by the Jedi at Ruusan, closing both the Jedi-Sith War and the long Sith Wars. The Sith, who had occupied Coruscant's Jedi Temple, are driven out and believed extinct.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

events.title: The Four Masters build the Jedi Temple
events.summary: On Coruscant, the Four Masters build a new Jedi Temple over the buried remains of the Sith shrine, hoping to smother its dark power while drawing on the site's strength in the Force. It serves as the Order's headquarters for the next thousand years.
events.conflict: Star Wars: Timelines dates the modern Temple to c. 1032 BBY, but Star Wars: Complete Locations says it was rebuilt about two thousand years before the Empire's rise, with remnants of an older temple set into its base.

events.title: Darth Bane creates the Rule of Two
events.summary: Sole survivor of his order, Darth Bane decrees that only two Sith may exist at once, one master, one apprentice, hiding in the shadows while his Grand Plan quietly works toward the ruin of the Republic and its Jedi. He is later entombed on Moraband.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: The modern Republic rises from the dark age
events.note: The Star Wars Book places the restoration 1,032 years before A New Hope, and Star Wars: Timelines has Valorum in office by 1032 BBY; Wookieepedia's timeline files the reformation loosely under c. 1000 BBY. Attack of the Clones' 'thousand years' refers to this Republic.
events.summary: With the Sith gone, the Old Republic reorganizes as the modern Republic, governed from Coruscant by a newly founded Galactic Senate. Its military is disbanded, Tarsus Valorum becomes the first Supreme Chancellor, and the preceding era is remembered as a dark age.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

events.title: The Jedi build their temple on Ilum
events.note: Fallen Order, set in 14 BBY, calls the temple a thousand years old.
events.summary: The Jedi build a temple over the largest cave mouth in Ilum's mountains. It becomes a pilgrimage site and home of the Gathering, the rite in which younglings seek the kyber crystals for their first lightsabers.

events.title: The Massassi die out
events.summary: The Massassi, the temple-building people of Yavin 4 thought to have served the Sith, become extinct, leaving their great stone temples to the jungle.
events.conflict: Star Wars: Timelines puts the extinction around 1000 BBY, but in Doctor Aphra (2016) 3, set about 0 ABY, the Massassi are said to have been extinct for millennia.

events.title: Dai Bendu monks settle Kijimi
events.summary: The Dai Bendu Monastery is built on the snowbound world of Kijimi, and a settlement called Kijimiko grows up around it, the future Kijimi City.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
events.conflict: Counting Poe Dameron: Free Fall's 'thousand years' back from 18 ABY gives c. 982 BBY for the city; The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary's thousand years before Kijimi's 35 ABY destruction gives c. 965 BBY for the monastery.

events.title: Maz Kanata is born
events.note: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary makes her 1,007 years old at the 34 ABY Starkiller incident.
events.summary: Maz Kanata is born. Force-sensitive and extraordinarily long-lived, she will become a legendary pirate queen whose castle on Takodana shelters smugglers for centuries.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: The Galactic Accord of Systems
events.summary: After the war with the Sith and the Republic's reformation, the Galactic Accord of Systems lays down rules of engagement for future wars, among them that an enemy who wishes to surrender must be allowed to.

events.title: Yoda is born
events.summary: Yoda is born, a member of a small, long-lived species whose homeworld he never reveals. Over nine centuries he will become the Jedi Order's revered Grand Master and teacher of generations of Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

events.title: Maz Kanata makes Takodana her home
events.summary: Maz Kanata makes her home on the forested world of Takodana. Her ancient castle there becomes a neutral haven where smugglers and spacers can rest and trade.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
events.conflict: Star Wars: Timelines dates her settling to c. 873 BBY, but in The Force Awakens Han Solo says she has run her watering hole for a thousand years.

events.title: Naboo enters the Republic
events.summary: Naboo becomes part of the Republic; each year its people will celebrate the anniversary with the Festival of Light.

events.title: King Jafan unites Naboo and founds Theed
events.summary: General Jafan ends Naboo's Time of Suffering, bringing its feuding city-states together through military might and sheer will. Crowned king, he founds Theed and its Royal Palace that same year, beginning Naboo's Great Time of Peace.

events.title: Yoda begins training Jedi
events.summary: Yoda takes on his first students. He will instruct Jedi for some eight hundred years, down to Luke Skywalker on Dagobah.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

events.title: Jabba the Hutt is born
events.summary: The Hutt Jabba comes into the world on Nal Hutta, a scion of Desilijic Tiure, one of the influential Hutt crime clans called kajidics. Over six centuries he will build a criminal empire run from Tatooine.

events.title: The Republic builds the Citadel for rogue Jedi
events.summary: On Lola Sayu, the Republic builds the Citadel, a prison for rogue Jedi set on a bridge between lakes of lava and powered by geothermal heat. Around 520 BBY it takes in the last rogue Jedi on record.
sources: Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy

events.title: Yaddle is born
events.summary: Yaddle, who shares Yoda's species, is born. She will grow into a Jedi Master and join the Council that leads the Order.
sources: Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded

events.title: The High Republic Era
events.summary: The Republic at its zenith and the Jedi at their height push out into the Outer Rim frontier: an age of exploration, great building works and relative peace, later shaken by the Path of the Open Hand, the Nihil and hidden Sith.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

events.title: The Path of the Open Hand is founded
events.summary: Breaking with the Guardians of the Whills on Jedha, the priest Sachar Rold starts a new sect on Dalna: the Path of the Open Hand, which holds that no one should wield the Force at all.
sources: Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia

events.title: Barnabas Vim shatters the Echo Stone
events.summary: Seeking the legendary Echo Stone, which magnifies bonds with the Force, Jedi Master Barnabas Vim and Padawan Vix Fonnick find it on Angcord, tainted by the dark side. They break it into three shards and part ways to hide them.
sources: The High Republic Adventures: Quest of the Jedi
Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia

events.title: Pathfinder teams push into the Outer Rim
events.summary: Co-Chancellors Kyong Greylark and Orlen Mollo send out Pathfinder teams, pairing Republic explorers with Jedi, to chart the Outer Rim and extend the Republic's reach into the lawless Galactic Frontier.

events.title: The Eiram and E'ronoh War
events.summary: When Niko A'lbaran, a prince of E'ronoh, dies on a mission to Eiram, the twin worlds' Forever War flares anew. A Republic summit betroths heirs Xiri A'lbaran and Phan-tu Zenn, but fighting flares until a treaty is sealed on their shared moon, Eirie.

events.title: The Great Hyperspace Rush
events.note: Wookieepedia's article ends the rush somewhere between c. 350 and c. 330 BBY; y2 is a midpoint.
events.summary: Prospectors race to map and claim hyperspace routes through the barely charted Outer Rim, making hyperlane travel safer and lifting the prospecting clans San Tekka and Graf to wealth and power.
sources: The High Republic: A Test of Courage
The High Republic: Path of Deceit

events.title: The Path unleashes the Great Leveler
events.summary: On Dalna the Path of the Open Hand hatches the Great Leveler, a Force-devouring Nameless beast. It petrifies two Jedi, Zallah Macri and Kevmo Zink, who were tracking the Rod of Seasons, an artifact Yana Ro then uses to command it.
sources: The High Republic: Path of Deceit

events.title: Porter Engle becomes the Blade of Bardotta
events.summary: Jedi Porter Engle and his sister Barash Silvain help drive a mercenary army from besieged Firevale on Gansevor; Silvain, blaming herself for the losses, distances herself from the Order. Engle later breaks a siege of Bardotta, winning fame as the Blade of Bardotta.

events.title: Pirate queen Maz Kanata battles the Dank Graks
events.summary: Maz Kanata, now a pirate queen, fights a turf war with the Dank Graks, a gang of castoffs from dark-side cults led by the Geonosian Arkik Von. Padawan Sav Malagán joins Maz undercover, and the Graks are finally beaten on Takodana.
events.wp: Turf war with the Dank Graks

events.title: The Battle of Jedha
events.summary: A Jedha summit meant to end the Eiram-E'ronoh war is bombed, and the Path of the Open Hand looses the Great Leveler on a Holy City riot. Fighting spreads, but Vildar Mac and Tey Sirrek stop the Path stealing the Rod of Daybreak.
sources: The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha
The High Republic: Path of Vengeance

events.title: The Night of Sorrow on Dalna
events.summary: Jedi and Republic envoys investigating the Path on Dalna are ambushed; its militant wing, the Path of the Closed Fist, sets Nameless creatures on them and many Jedi die. Helped by fighters from Eiram and E'ronoh, the Jedi finally crush the cult.
sources: The High Republic: Path of Vengeance

events.title: Marda Ro founds the Nihil
events.summary: Discovering that the Path's Mother, Elecia Zeveron, was secretly Force-sensitive, Marda Ro turns the Great Leveler on her. She then leaves Dalna and gathers a band of marauders that grows into the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: Path of Vengeance

events.title: Yoda and Creighton Sun bury the Nameless secret
events.summary: After the slaughter on Dalna, Yoda and Master Creighton Sun decide to keep the Nameless, Force-draining creatures, a secret so that no one can turn them on the Jedi. The secret holds until the Nihil wield them some 150 years later.

events.title: The Ro family abducts Mari San Tekka
events.summary: Mari San Tekka, a San Tekka girl gifted with the ability to sense routes through hyperspace, is seized by an Evereni of the Ro family. Her secret Paths will later let the Nihil strike and vanish at will.

events.title: The Techno Union takes over Mustafar
events.summary: Mustafar falls under the control of the Techno Union, which rents the volcanic world back to its native Mustafarians and supplies the machinery they use to mine it. Their labor pays the rent, and Mustafar becomes a mining hub.
sources: Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Asgar Ro becomes Eye of the Nihil
events.summary: Impatient for war on the Republic, Asgar Ro kills his mother Shalla aboard the Gaze Electric. He then reveals the hyperspace Paths secretly supplied by Mari San Tekka, has his son Marchion prove them in battle, and names himself Eye of the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 1

events.title: Marchion Ro kills his father, seizes the Nihil
events.summary: Believing Asgar Ro's son will be easier to manipulate, the Tempest Runners plot against the Eye, and Lourna Dee stabs him. Marchion finds his dying father and finishes him himself, becoming Eye of the Nihil and proving far harder to control.

events.title: Lina Soh wins the chancellorship
events.summary: Lina Soh of Daghee wins election as Supreme Chancellor, promising to extend the Republic's reach. Her Great Works, from mass-produced bacta to Starlight Beacon, aim to bind the galaxy together and draw in the Outer Rim.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

events.title: The Nihil conflict
events.summary: Beginning with the Great Hyperspace Disaster and ending in their surrender at Eriadu, the Nihil wage four years of raids, terror and conquest on the Republic and its Jedi, at their height destroying Starlight Beacon and walling off the Occlusion Zone.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi
The High Republic: The Fallen Star
The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

events.title: The Great Hyperspace Disaster
events.summary: The freighter Legacy Run is torn apart in hyperspace after meeting a Nihil ship, and its wreckage erupts into realspace as deadly projectiles. Jedi and Republic forces race to shield the Hetzal system. Marchion Ro and his Nihil are secretly behind the catastrophe.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi
The High Republic: The Rising Storm

events.title: The Nihil overrun Tanalorr
events.note: Wookieepedia places it in 232 BBY because it falls between the Great Hyperspace Disaster and the end of the Emergences.
events.summary: While the Jedi assess Tanalorr as a possible training world, the Nihil strike without warning and overwhelm its defenders. The Jedi Council gives up the planet, and Jedi Knight Dagan Gera, embittered by the loss, eventually betrays the Order.
sources: Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi

events.title: Stranded Jedi awaken the Drengir
events.summary: Thrown from hyperspace by the Great Disaster, a group of Jedi and the Vessel's crew shelter on an old Amaxine station. Under Nihil attack they destroy a set of statues, releasing the Drengir the Sith had sealed inside long ago.
sources: The High Republic: Into the Dark

events.title: Starlight Beacon is dedicated
events.summary: Starlight Beacon, a Republic station with a Jedi temple at its heart, built as a Great Work to guide travelers and relay signals across the Outer Rim, is dedicated before Chancellor Soh, Yoda and Pra-Tre Veter, with Avar Kriss as marshal.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

events.title: Young Jedi defend the Tenoo temple
events.summary: Aiming to push the Jedi out of the Bri'ahl sector, Gangul chief Sellaccc Orryak seizes the Tenoo Jedi Temple, but Padawan Wes Vinik, youngling Kai Brightstar and their friends rally allies and win it back.

events.title: The Drengir crisis
events.summary: Revived Drengir spread through the Outer Rim, preying on Sedri Minor and overrunning Hutt cities on Nal Hutta. Jedi and Hutts join forces, and Avar Kriss leads a strike on the Drengir homeworld Mulita that captures their Great Progenitor.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm

events.title: The Nihil strike the Republic Fair on Valo
events.summary: Chancellor Soh's Republic Fair on Valo, staged to show the galaxy's recovery from the Great Disaster, is ravaged by a Nihil assault while the Jedi are distracted. The raiders are repelled, but hundreds of thousands die.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm
The High Republic: Race to Crashpoint Tower

events.title: Loden Greatstorm dies at the Battle of Grizal
events.summary: Jedi track Nihil raiders home to Grizal and storm their base. Marchion Ro sets the Great Leveler loose, and it kills Loden Greatstorm, long a Nihil captive, before his Padawan Bell Zettifar; the Jedi leave believing Lourna Dee leads the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm

events.title: Gravity's Heart falls; Mari San Tekka dies
events.summary: Republic and Jedi forces destroy Gravity's Heart, a Nihil station housing Chancey Yarrow's gravity-well weapon, and free captive Jedi. Dying, the Nihil's navigator Mari San Tekka hands Vernestra Rwoh one last hyperspace route.
sources: The High Republic: Out of the Shadows

events.title: The Nihil destroy Dalna
events.summary: Nihil scientist Zadina Mkampa uses a crystal matrix buried in Dalna's crust to trigger quakes and volcanic devastation. Imri Cantaros helps organize a rescue in which Starlight Beacon itself is hauled across hyperspace to evacuate the Dalnans.
sources: The High Republic: Mission to Disaster

events.title: Marchion Ro captures Nameless on Planet X
events.summary: Guided by his family's lore, Marchion Ro sacrifices waves of Nihil strikeships to distract the storm veil around Planet X, slips through with his loyal She'ar, and wields the Rod of Seasons to seize a clutch of Nameless.
sources: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 2

events.title: Starlight Beacon falls
events.summary: Nihil saboteurs and Nameless creatures cripple Starlight Beacon, and the station plunges onto Eiram. Stellan Gios gives his life steering it clear of Barraza City. Marchion Ro then steps into the open, proclaiming to the whole galaxy that he leads the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: The Fallen Star
The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 5

events.title: The Stormwall seals the Occlusion Zone
events.summary: Deploying stormseeds, the Nihil raise the Stormwall, a barrier impassable to hyperspace travel and communications, and enclose ten sectors, Valo among them, in their Occlusion Zone. A Republic fleet is lost, and Avar Kriss is among the Jedi trapped inside.
sources: The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1
The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 2
The High Republic: Escape from Valo

events.title: The Jedi invoke the Guardian Protocols
events.summary: A week after Starlight's fall, with most Jedi already recalled to Coruscant, the Council puts the Guardian Protocols into effect, fast-tracking learners through the ranks and readying the Order for open war on the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1

events.title: Marchion Ro executes Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter
events.summary: Marking a year since Starlight's fall, Marchion Ro has Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter, captured months earlier in a Nihil ambush on Asternin, put to death on a live broadcast.
sources: The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness

events.title: The Nihil occupy Naboo
events.summary: Forces under Nihil General Abediah Viess conquer Naboo, and its queen escapes into hiding. Jedi and Republic troops led by Avar Kriss later free the planet, though Viess slips away.
sources: The High Republic: Temptation of the Force

events.title: The Battle of Eriadu ends the Nihil conflict
events.summary: Republic fleets, Jedi and furious Eriaduans rallied by the Tarkin family, joined by Hutt, Togruta and Mon Calamari forces, fight the Nihil occupiers for Eriadu. The Nihil surrender, General Viess and the Warden die, and the Nihil conflict ends.
sources: The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

events.title: The Luminous Nine on Planet X
events.summary: Nine Jedi and former Jedi carry the Nameless home to Planet X to halt the blight. Marchion Ro kills the creatures and wrecks his flagship, dropping the Stormwall, but is captured; Avar Kriss and Elzar Mann stay to hold the blight in check.
sources: The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

events.title: Marchion Ro is tried and imprisoned
events.summary: Put on trial in the Senate Building on Coruscant for crimes including Starlight Beacon's destruction, Marchion Ro receives a life sentence of solitary confinement, his prison to be built by droids at a random spot in deep space.
sources: The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

events.title: Mostima and Sean expose Land & Sky
events.summary: Jedi Master Mostima and her Padawan Sean look into a killing in the far-flung Aakaash system and expose how deeply Land & Sky, the corporation that governs it, is corrupted.

events.title: Chewbacca is born
events.note: In Solo: A Star Wars Story, set around 10 BBY, he gives his age as 190.
events.summary: The Wookiee Chewbacca is born on his people's homeworld, Kashyyyk. Some two centuries on he will fly the Millennium Falcon as Han Solo's partner and co-pilot.

events.title: The Jedi Annexation Act fails
events.note: The Acolyte: Wayseeker, set about 160 BBY, places the attempt three years earlier.
events.summary: Senator Jakob Garn tries to push the Jedi Annexation Act through the Senate, a bill that would fold the Order into the Republic as a formal branch under Senate oversight. It fails to pass.

events.title: Osha and Mae Aniseya are born on Brendok
events.note: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide makes Osha 24 in 132 BBY.
events.summary: On Brendok, the witch Aniseya uses a Force vergence to create twin daughters, Osha and Mae, whom her partner Koril carries and bears. The girls are raised within the coven's fortress.
sources: Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide

events.title: Tragedy on Brendok
events.note: Set sixteen years before The Acolyte, which is placed in 132 BBY (a century before The Phantom Menace).
events.summary: Investigating a Force vergence on Brendok, Jedi Sol, Indara, Torbin and Kelnacca find a coven raising twin girls. Their attempt to take Osha for training ends in fire and killings that destroy the coven; Osha joins the Order believing Mae dead.

events.title: Mae becomes the Stranger's acolyte
events.note: The Visual Guide says she began training two years before the series' 132 BBY events.
events.summary: Mae Aniseya, secretly alive, becomes apprentice to a Sith Lord called only the Stranger, who poses as the antiques dealer Qimir. He schools her in dark-side lore and bladework, and aims her revenge at the Brendok Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide

events.title: Mae murders Jedi Master Indara
events.note: The Acolyte is dated to 132 BBY as a century before The Phantom Menace.
events.summary: Sent to avenge Brendok, Mae kills Jedi Master Indara in a noodle shop on Ueda. The Jedi, with no record of Mae, arrest her twin Osha, now a ship mechanic, until Master Sol comes to believe Mae survived.

events.title: The Stranger slaughters the Jedi on Khofar
events.summary: After Torbin's death on Olega, Mae balks at killing Kelnacca on Khofar, but the Stranger kills him anyway. He then wipes out the Jedi team that arrives too late, including Jecki Lon and Yord Fandar; only Sol and Osha survive.

events.title: Sol dies on Brendok; the Jedi cover up
events.summary: Back on Brendok, Sol admits killing the twins' mother, and Osha strikes him down. The Stranger wipes Mae's memory and takes Osha as his apprentice. Vernestra Rwoh blames the Jedi deaths on Sol to head off a Senate inquiry.

events.title: A treaty shields Mandalore from Republic invasion
events.note: Only known to be in force at least a century before the 19 BBY Siege of Mandalore.
events.summary: By now a treaty forbids the Republic to invade Mandalore. A century later, the Republic-backed campaign to oust Maul from Mandalore will be called a breach of it.

events.title: Dooku is born on Serenno
events.summary: Dooku is born into House Serenno. Alarmed by the baby's Force powers, Count Gora leaves him in the forest outside the palace, where a Jedi seeker finds him and brings him to the Jedi on Coruscant. He will become Count Dooku.

events.title: Sifo-Dyas is born
events.summary: On Minashee, Sifo-Dyas is born. Raised a Jedi alongside Dooku, he will one day secretly order the clone army that fights the Clone Wars.

events.title: Sand People overrun Fort Tusken
events.summary: Sand People raid and loot Fort Tusken, an outpost beside Tatooine's Jundland Wastes, until its surviving settlers give it up. The fort's chroniclers later make the raiders' siege ballistas famous and give them the name Tusken Raiders.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian Visual Guide

events.title: Young Dooku meets his lost family
events.summary: During a Jedi visit to a Serenno festival, the youngling Dooku saves two children from kidnappers and learns they are his siblings, Jenza and Ramil. A groundquake buries him in rubble, and his father, Count Gora, rages that he never wants him back.

events.title: Yoda takes Dooku as his Padawan
events.summary: After the Hawk-Bat Clan's Initiate Trials, Grand Master Yoda picks Dooku as his apprentice, and Lene Kostana takes Dooku's close friend Sifo-Dyas. One pupil will one day lead the Separatists; the other will commission the clone army.

events.title: Solar storm devastates Protobranch
events.summary: Sifo-Dyas foresees a deadly solar storm on Protobranch. The Council refuses to act on a vision, so he, Dooku and Master Kostana warn the world's senator anyway, and Yoda reluctantly follows them there; the storm still kills much of the population.

events.title: Sheev Palpatine is born on Naboo
events.summary: Naboo sees the birth of Sheev Palpatine in the closing years of the High Republic era. Secretly schooled by the Sith Lord Darth Plagueis, he will become Darth Sidious and, in the end, the galaxy's Emperor.

events.title: Dooku first wields Force lightning
events.summary: Hunting rumored Sith relics with Lene Kostana and Sifo-Dyas, the Padawan Dooku is seized on Asusto by a dark side coven, the Presagers of Hakotei. Their ritual fills him with visions of what is to come, and he escapes by killing them with Force lightning.

events.title: Qui-Gon Jinn is born on Coruscant
events.note: Derived from his age of forty in Master & Apprentice, which is set in 40 BBY.
events.summary: Qui-Gon Jinn comes into the world on Coruscant. Trained by Dooku, he grows into a maverick Jedi Master devoted to the Living Force, whose discovery of a slave boy on Tatooine will set the Chosen One's story in motion.

events.title: Mace Windu is born on Haruun Kal
events.summary: Mace Windu comes into the world on Haruun Kal. He will become Master of the Order, a peerless duelist and one of the very few Jedi to face Darth Sidious blade to blade.
sources: Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force

events.title: Dooku takes Qui-Gon as his Padawan
events.summary: When the Heliost Clan completes its Initiate Trials, Dooku, now a Jedi Master, picks the young Qui-Gon Jinn to be his Padawan. The same year master and student see combat together on Shurrupak.

events.title: Theed power generator opens
events.summary: A venture between Naboo and Damask Holdings builds a plasma-refining generator in Theed, its stark industrial look a break with Naboo style. Surplus plasma is sold off-world, much of it to the Trade Federation. Decades later, Qui-Gon Jinn dies fighting inside it.
events.conflict: Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016) has Senator Palpatine attend the opening, which Nexus of Power dates to 65 BBY, but Star Wars: Timelines dates his election as senator to 52 BBY.

events.title: Wilhuff Tarkin is born on Eriadu
events.summary: Wilhuff Tarkin is born into Eriadu's powerful Tarkin family. Drawn into politics by Palpatine, he will serve the Republic as an officer, then the Empire as a Grand Moff and the Death Star's commander.

events.title: The future Millennium Falcon is built
events.summary: A YT-1300 freighter from Corellia enters service around this time. After many owners and many names it will become the Millennium Falcon, flown by Lando Calrissian and then Han Solo.

events.title: Dooku offered a seat on the Council
events.note: Star Wars: Timelines dates Dooku's Council seat to around 58 BBY; the rally attack comes shortly before it.
events.summary: Probing the sabotage that nearly kills his brother Ramil at Coruscant's Dragonfire Air Rally, Dooku and Qui-Gon find that a crime lord is blackmailing Councilor Yula Braylon. Dooku is then offered a place on the High Council, while Qui-Gon is made a Knight.
events.wp: Attack at the Dragonfire Air Rally

events.title: Obi-Wan Kenobi is born on Stewjon
events.summary: Born on Stewjon, Obi-Wan Kenobi reaches the Jedi Temple before he is half a year old. He will train under Qui-Gon Jinn, teach Anakin Skywalker, and decades later guide Anakin's son Luke.

events.title: Maul is born on Dathomir
events.summary: On Dathomir, the Nightsister leader Mother Talzin bears a Zabrak son, Maul. Taken as a boy by Darth Sidious, he will be shaped into a Sith assassin consumed by hatred for the Jedi.

events.title: Palpatine elected Senator of Naboo
events.summary: Sheev Palpatine wins the seat representing Naboo in the Galactic Senate. Already secretly Darth Sidious, apprentice to Darth Plagueis, he gives the Sith a foothold for taking the Republic apart from within.

events.title: Councilor Katri slain on Raxus Secundus
events.summary: Sent to bring home Councilor Katri's body, Dooku and Mace Windu learn that local guards killed her while trying to coerce their corrupt senator, who dies in the fallout. Windu inherits Katri's Council seat; Dooku comes away half-sympathetic to the killers' complaint against the Senate.

events.title: Rael Averross forced to kill his Padawan
events.summary: Mutineers rise aboard the relief freighter Advent. Rael Averross fights them in the cargo hold rather than retake the bridge, and a slicer dart turns his Padawan Nim Pianna on him, so he must kill her. The Council clears him and posts him to Pijal.

events.title: Padmé Naberrie is born on Naboo
events.summary: Ruwee and Jobal Naberrie welcome a daughter, Padmé, on Naboo. She will be elected queen at fourteen, serve as a senator through the Clone Wars, and secretly marry Anakin Skywalker.

events.title: Qui-Gon takes Obi-Wan as his Padawan
events.summary: Qui-Gon Jinn chooses the young Obi-Wan Kenobi to be his Padawan. The pairing of an unorthodox master with a rule-minded student is often uneasy, but it holds for twelve years, until Qui-Gon's death on Naboo.

events.title: Ky Narec takes in Asajj Ventress
events.summary: Marooned on Rattatak, a world ruled by warlords, Ky Narec of the Jedi finds the girl Asajj Ventress after raiders kill the man who owned her. Sensing her power, he trains her as his Padawan while the two defend the locals.

events.title: Dooku becomes Count and quits the Jedi
events.summary: Dooku's brother Ramil hires Abyssin mercenaries to sour Serenno on the Republic. Dooku returns home, kills Ramil and claims the title and fortune of Count, then resigns from the Order at sixty. Earlier that year he had been introduced to Senator Palpatine.

events.title: Anakin Skywalker is born
events.summary: The enslaved Shmi Skywalker gives birth to a son who has no father. Anakin is a Force vergence, and the Jedi will come to believe him the prophesied Chosen One who will restore the Force's balance.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
events.conflict: The Star Wars Book gives Tatooine as his birthplace, while Darth Vader: Sith Lord says records disagree and that he may have reached Tatooine with his mother as a small child.

events.title: Grogu is born
events.note: Derived from his stated age of fifty in The Mandalorian, which Star Wars: Timelines places in 9 ABY.
events.summary: Grogu, of the same rare species as Yoda, is born and raised as an initiate in the Jedi Temple. Carried to safety when the Temple falls, he will resurface decades later as the ward of the Mandalorian Din Djarin.

events.title: Mandalore's Great Clan Wars
events.note: Placed after Padawan (41 BBY per Star Wars: Timelines), in which Obi-Wan has not yet met Satine, and before the mission to Pijal (40 BBY), which followed the war.
events.summary: Pacifist New Mandalorians fight the martial traditionalists in a civil war that wrecks the old capital, Keldabe. Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan spend a year guarding Satine Kryze, who falls for Obi-Wan; her side wins, and the exiled traditionalists become Death Watch.

events.title: Sidious takes Maul as his apprentice
events.summary: Darth Sidious visits Mother Talzin on Dathomir and, instead of the apprenticeship she hoped for, leaves with her young son Maul. Talzin never forgives the theft, and Maul trains for years as the Sith's hidden weapon against the Jedi.
events.conflict: In Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir, Talzin says Sidious stole Maul from her; the in-universe legend An Unwilling Apprentice has Talzin surrender him at Sidious's demand before Sidious chooses him at a Selection contest.

events.title: Sidious murders Darth Plagueis
events.note: No source names the year. The StarWars.com Databank places the murder after Sidious took Maul as apprentice (c. 40 BBY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before the Invasion of Naboo (32 BBY).
events.summary: Having learned all he needs, Darth Sidious kills his master, Plagueis the Wise, as he sleeps, just as the Rule of Two demands. He inherits Plagueis's research into cheating death, the lure he will later dangle before Anakin Skywalker.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith

events.title: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan's mission to Pijal
events.summary: Qui-Gon and young Obi-Wan travel to Pijal to oversee a treaty between its monarchy and Czerka, working with the regent Rael Averross. They find Princess Fanry herself behind the Blackguard terrorists, and her coronation is stopped. Qui-Gon also declines a High Council seat.

events.title: Sifo-Dyas joins the Jedi High Council
events.summary: Sifo-Dyas joins the Council that leads the Jedi Order. His recurring visions of a coming war increasingly set him against his fellow councilors, and he will eventually act on them without their consent.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Gardulla loses Anakin and Shmi to Watto
events.summary: The Hutt crime lord Gardulla bets on the podraces and loses two of her slaves to Watto, a Toydarian who runs a junk shop in Mos Espa: Shmi Skywalker and her small son Anakin.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know

events.title: Ahsoka Tano is born on Shili
events.summary: In a Togruta village on Shili, a girl named Ahsoka Tano is born. Found by Plo Koon a few years later, she will become Anakin Skywalker's Padawan and, after leaving the Order, a key figure of the rebellion era.

events.title: Thrawn's trap in the Kinoss system
events.summary: To prove the Lioaoin Regime backs piracy, the young Chiss officer Thrawn poses as a merchant and draws pirate corsairs through hyperspace into the Kinoss system, where Ar'alani's patrol cruiser Parala destroys them. It opens the Chiss campaign against the Lioaoin pirates.

events.title: Battle of the Malastare Narrows
events.summary: Admiral Trench of the Corporate Alliance blockades Malastare and mauls the Republic fleet sent against him, with Wullf Yularen among its officers. A Jedi task force under Kep-She wrecks Trench's flagship; he is thought dead but survives.

events.title: Sidious brings Maul to Malachor
events.summary: Sidious takes his apprentice to Malachor, where the ash of Sith warriors killed in an ancient battle gives Maul visions of their deaths at Jedi hands. The experience deepens his loathing for the Jedi Order.

events.title: Ky Narec killed; Dooku claims Ventress
events.note: Star Wars: Timelines puts her apprenticeship to Narec in 44 BBY and Dark Disciple says they served Rattatak for ten years, placing his death around 34 BBY; Dooku finds her some time after.
events.summary: Pirates kill Ky Narec, and the grieving Ventress makes herself warlord of Rattatak until a rival, Osika Kirske, captures her and forces her into his arena. Count Dooku frees her and makes her his dark side pupil and assassin.

events.title: Sifo-Dyas secretly orders a clone army
events.summary: Convinced by his visions that war is coming, Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas secretly commissions the cloners of Kamino to grow the Republic an army, without the Jedi Council's approval. The Sith soon take quiet control of the project.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
events.conflict: Star Wars: Timelines and Star Wars Insider 206 place the order in 33 BBY, while in Attack of the Clones the Kaminoans date it to almost ten years before 22 BBY, nearer 32 BBY.

events.title: Massacre at the Eriadu Conference
events.summary: At a trade summit held on Eriadu, the radical Nebula Front kills much of the Trade Federation's leadership and several Kuat Drive Yards executives, while Chancellor Valorum survives an attempt on his life. Nute Gunray rises to Viceroy, as Darth Sidious intended.

events.title: Maul hunts a captive Padawan
events.summary: Sent to silence witnesses to the Trade Federation's plans, Maul hears that the Xrexus Cartel is auctioning a captured Padawan, Eldra Kaitis. With Cad Bane and Aurra Sing he takes her, then duels and kills her, hungry for a real fight with the Jedi.

events.title: Padmé crowned Queen Amidala
events.summary: At fourteen, Padmé Naberrie unseats the isolationist Queen Sanandrassa and is crowned under the regnal name Amidala. With Captain Panaka she recruits handmaidens who serve as her decoys and guards.

events.title: Senate taxes the Free Trade Zones
events.summary: At Chancellor Valorum's urging, the Senate passes Prop 31-814D, taxing trade in the outlying Free Trade Zones. The Trade Federation's fury over the levy hands Darth Sidious the pretext he needs.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

events.title: Trade Federation blockades and invades Naboo
events.summary: Secretly steered by Darth Sidious, the Federation throws a blockade around Naboo over the tax, tries to kill the Jedi envoys sent to negotiate, and lands a droid army that takes Theed. Queen Amidala will not sign a treaty making the occupation legal.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Anakin wins the Boonta Eve Classic
events.summary: Stranded on Tatooine with the Queen, Qui-Gon Jinn meets the slave boy Anakin Skywalker and senses his enormous Force potential. Anakin wins the Boonta Eve podrace, earning parts for the Queen's ship and his own freedom, and leaves his mother to become a Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: The Sith reveal themselves on Tatooine
events.summary: Tracking the Queen's ship, Darth Maul ambushes Qui-Gon Jinn in the desert outside Mos Espa. Qui-Gon escapes aboard the departing starship and reports the first Sith warrior seen by the Jedi in about a thousand years.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Amidala topples Chancellor Valorum
events.summary: With her appeal lost in Senate procedure, Queen Amidala takes Senator Palpatine's advice and moves to oust Chancellor Valorum through a no-confidence vote. Valorum falls, and Amidala leaves Coruscant resolved to free Naboo herself.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Dooku erases Kamino from the Archives
events.summary: Visiting the Jedi Temple as Qui-Gon reports his clash with a Sith, Dooku slips into the Archives and uses Sifo-Dyas's clearance to scrub Kamino's star system from the records, keeping the Jedi ignorant of the clone army.

events.title: Palpatine elected Supreme Chancellor
events.note: Elected while Amidala returns to Naboo; he arrives there as Chancellor after the battle.
events.summary: Buoyed by sympathy for his occupied homeworld, Senator Palpatine of Naboo wins the Senate's backing to replace Valorum at the head of the Republic. No one suspects that its new leader is the Sith Lord who engineered the crisis that raised him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Battle of Naboo
events.summary: Now allied with the Gungans, Amidala strikes back: the Gungan army draws the droids onto the grasslands, the Queen captures Viceroy Gunray in the palace, and young Anakin destroys the droid control ship, shutting down the invasion army.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Maul kills Qui-Gon Jinn
events.summary: Deep in Theed's power generator, Darth Maul runs Qui-Gon Jinn through. Obi-Wan Kenobi avenges him, cutting Maul in two and sending him down a reactor shaft. Presumed dead, Maul survives and later hides on the junk world Lotho Minor.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Obi-Wan knighted and takes Anakin as Padawan
events.summary: The Council raises Obi-Wan Kenobi to Knight and, honoring Qui-Gon's last wish, lets him train Anakin Skywalker despite Yoda's doubts. Qui-Gon is cremated on Naboo, and a parade in Theed celebrates the new peace between Naboo's humans and Gungans.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Dooku kills Yaddle and becomes Tyranus
events.summary: Shaken by Qui-Gon's death, Dooku meets Darth Sidious in secret. Master Yaddle follows him and confronts them both; at Sidious's urging Dooku kills her, completing his fall. He is reborn as Darth Tyranus, Sidious's new apprentice.

events.title: Sifo-Dyas murdered on Tyranus's orders
events.summary: Pushed off the Council for warning of war, Sifo-Dyas has gone in secret to Oba Diah with Silman, Valorum's personal aide, to bargain with the Pykes. On Tyranus's orders the Pykes shoot down his shuttle, and Silman is held as a hostage.

events.title: Tyranus recruits Jango Fett as clone template
events.summary: As Tyranus, Dooku recruits the renowned bounty hunter Jango Fett, whose DNA will be copied for the entire Kaminoan army. Under Sith direction, every clone is also fitted with a behavioral chip that will compel obedience to Order 66.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Boba Fett is born on Kamino
events.summary: As part of his fee, Jango Fett takes an unaltered clone to raise as his son, Boba. A near-identical female clone, later called Omega, stays on Kamino as assistant to the scientist Nala Se.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Secret orders for a clone war fleet
events.summary: An unnamed buyer places vast orders for weapons and warships with Kuat Drive Yards, whose subsidiary Rothana Heavy Engineering quietly designs Acclamator-class assault ships to carry the clone army growing on Kamino.

events.title: Sidious begins his Jakku observatory
events.summary: Darth Sidious starts building a secret observatory on the desert world Jakku. By 25 BBY his adviser Yupe Tashu has droids digging into the Plaintive Hand plateau, guarded by the orphan Gallius Rax, newly taken into Sidious's service.

events.title: Obi-Wan and Anakin on Carnelion IV
events.summary: Answering a distress call, Obi-Wan and his twelve-year-old Padawan find Carnelion IV torn apart by the Open–Closed War, and a Republic fleet arrives to enforce a ceasefire. Meanwhile Chancellor Palpatine cultivates Anakin, even touring Coruscant's lower levels with him incognito.

events.title: Padmé Amidala becomes Senator of Naboo
events.summary: After two terms, Padmé Amidala leaves the throne. Her successor, Queen Réillata, asks her to represent Naboo in the Galactic Senate, where she soon campaigns for relief to the quake-stricken world Bromlarch alongside Senator Rush Clovis.

events.title: Cliegg Lars frees and marries Shmi
events.summary: Tatooine farmer Cliegg Lars purchases Shmi Skywalker's freedom from Watto and marries her, taking her to his homestead. Anakin, far away in Jedi training, does not learn of it until years later.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Thrawn breaks the Vagaari; Thrass dies
events.summary: Senior Captain Thrawn leads the Chiss to a crushing win over the Vagaari pirates, but a ship from outside Chiss space, caught up in the fighting, crashes and kills his adoptive brother, Syndic Thrass. The Ascendancy's rulers blame Thrawn and take his cruiser Springhawk.

events.title: Tyranus arms the coming war on Sullust
events.summary: On Sidious's orders, Tyranus reaches a deal on Sullust with the Kaldana Syndicate of arms dealers while, as Count Dooku, he signs a trade pact between Serenno and SoroSuub. When the Jedi Jak'zin comes to investigate, Dooku kills him.

events.title: Galen and Lyra Erso marry
events.summary: The scientist Galen Erso marries Lyra, whom he met on Espinar, in a ceremony on Coruscant. Galen's work on crystal-based energy will draw the attention of his old friend Orson Krennic and, through him, the Republic's hidden weapons program.
events.wp: Wedding of Lyra and Galen Erso
sources: Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide

events.title: Dooku's Raxus Address launches the Separatists
events.summary: Count Dooku denounces a corrupt Republic in the Raxus Address and founds the Separatist Confederacy. Thousands of star systems secede and form their own Separatist Senate, opening the Separatist Crisis that will end in open war.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
events.conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline dates the Confederacy's founding both to this address in 24 BBY (Rise of the Separatists, Star Wars: Timelines) and to the Geonosian accord of 22 BBY, when its corporate backers formally join (Attack of the Clones).

events.title: Emergency Powers Act keeps Palpatine in office
events.summary: As systems secede, the Senate amends the constitution so Chancellor Palpatine can stay in office past his term limits while the crisis lasts. Palpatine gathers trusted senators, Padmé Amidala among them, into a Loyalist Committee.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: The Andors take Kassa from Kenari
events.summary: Children of Kenari's Alpha tribe explore a crashed transport bearing the new Separatist emblem, and a surviving officer kills their leader. The boy Kassa stays behind in the wreck, where the salvagers Maarva and Clem Andor find him and take him off-world as Cassian.
events.wp: Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft

events.title: Amidala fights the Military Creation Act
events.summary: The Military Creation Act, a bill to raise an army against the Separatists, has been debated since the secessions began. Although she sits on Palpatine's Loyalist Committee, Senator Amidala leads the resistance to it, and her stand makes her a target.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Assassins target Senator Amidala
events.summary: Separatist leaders hire Jango Fett to silence Senator Amidala before the army vote. A bomb on her landing platform kills her decoy and poisonous kouhuns fail to finish the job; when his agent Zam Wesell is caught, Jango kills her before she can talk.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Obi-Wan discovers the clone army
events.summary: Following a poisoned dart to Kamino, a planet absent from the Jedi records, Obi-Wan Kenobi finds a vast clone army supposedly commissioned by the dead Sifo-Dyas and grown from Jango Fett. He trails Jango to Geonosis, where the Separatists are massing droids.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Shmi dies; Anakin slaughters the Tuskens
events.summary: Haunted by nightmares, Anakin returns to Tatooine and finds his mother, seized weeks earlier by Tusken Raiders, dying in their camp. When she dies he massacres the whole camp, then confesses his rage to Padmé.
events.wp: Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Senate grants war powers; clone army activated
events.summary: With Separatist droid armies revealed on Geonosis, Representative Jar Jar Binks moves to give Chancellor Palpatine emergency powers. The Senate agrees, and Palpatine's first act is to commission the Kaminoan clones as the Republic's Grand Army.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: The Clone Wars
events.summary: For three years, clone troopers led by Jedi generals battle the Separatist droid armies across the galaxy. Darth Sidious secretly steers both sides, and when the fighting stops the Jedi Order lies in ruins and the Republic has become his Empire.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: First Battle of Geonosis opens the war
events.summary: Some two hundred Jedi storm the Geonosis arena to save Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé, and most die before Yoda arrives with the clones. Jango Fett falls to Mace Windu, and Dooku maims Anakin before escaping with plans for a battle station.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Anakin and Padmé marry in secret
events.summary: Defying the Jedi rule against attachment, Anakin and Padmé wed in secret at the lake retreat of Varykino on Naboo, with only C-3PO and the astromech R2-D2 as witnesses.
events.wp: Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Bombing of Zarra on Cato Neimoidia
events.summary: A blast tears a district of the bridge city Zarra from its moorings, killing thousands on Cato Neimoidia. Obi-Wan and a Neimoidian guard, Ruug Quarnom, find a third party behind it, and the newly knighted Anakin defies orders to save his master from Ventress's frame-up.

events.title: Battle of Christophsis
