events.title: Cloud City liberated
events.note: The Visual Dictionary sets it twenty-nine years before the Starkiller Incident (34 ABY).
events.summary: Relaying Lando's messages, Lobot rallies the Bespin Wing Guard against Governor Adelhard's regime. The Anoat sector uprising headed by the Smuggler then frees Cloud City and makes it the rebellion's base.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Shadow Wing breaks Syndulla's flagship
events.summary: Hera Syndulla's battle group grinds through the Cerberon system to take the Imperial-held world Troithe. Shadow Wing ambushes her flagship Lodestar, which breaks apart and falls on the city below, leaving both forces shattered.
sources: Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

events.title: Arkanis falls; the Huxes escape
events.summary: New Republic forces lay siege to Arkanis, an Imperial bastion. Before it falls, Gallius Rax sends the hunter Mercurial Swift to smuggle academy commandant Brendol Hux and young Armitage off-world.

events.title: Kuat's shipyards surrender
events.summary: After weeks of fighting, Ackbar's fleet wins the orbital shipyards of Kuat. Moff Pollus Maksim surrenders on his vice admiral's advice, and losing its greatest yards cripples the Empire's ability to rebuild its navy.

events.title: Wookiees freed on Kashyyyk
events.summary: Ackbar's fleet breaks Grand Moff Tolruck's breakaway Imperial regime above Kashyyyk while Han, Chewbacca and Norra Wexley's team fight on the ground, freeing the Wookiee homeworld after years of enslavement.

events.title: Peace talks end in bloodshed on Chandrila
events.summary: Gallius Rax lets Rae Sloane open peace talks with Mon Mothma in Hanna City, but it is a ruse: freed Kashyyyk prisoners fitted with controller chips attack Republic leaders, wounding Mothma and ending hopes of a negotiated peace.

events.title: Rax gathers the Empire at Jakku
events.summary: Carrying out Palpatine's Contingency, Counselor Gallius Rax pulls the remaining Imperial fleet to remote Jakku. He means to lure the Republic there, destroy the planet with both sides on it, and slip away with a chosen few to the Unknown Regions.

events.title: Ben Solo is born on Chandrila
events.summary: Leia Organa goes into labor at the Galactic Concordance ceremony on Chandrila, and Han hurries her off to a hospital, where she delivers their son, Ben Solo. The son of two war heroes will one day call himself Kylo Ren.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Republic and Empire stand down their militaries
events.note: Follows the Galactic Concordance, dated 5 ABY; the Republic's own Military Disarmament Act passed c. 4 ABY.
events.summary: With the war formally over, the New Republic and what is left of the Empire halt hostilities and begin disarming. Mon Mothma's Republic keeps only a small defense force, a choice that leaves it exposed when a new Imperial threat rises.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Inner systems' Imperial remnant falls apart
events.summary: The Concordance lets loyalist Core and Inner Rim worlds such as Commenor, Rendili and Denon form an Imperial rump state, but it collapses almost at once in bickering. Many of its worlds later drift into the Senate's Centrist bloc.
sources: Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy

events.title: Imperial holdouts regroup in the Unknown Regions
events.summary: After a flight of several months, Rae Sloane and Brendol Hux reach the late Emperor's dreadnought Eclipse and link up with other Imperials who escaped into uncharted space. The hidden remnant grows strong and starts turning the ice world Ilum into a superweapon.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Luke begins hunting lost Jedi lore
events.note: Dated 29 years before the Starkiller Incident (34 ABY) by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
events.summary: With the Empire beaten, Luke Skywalker starts combing the galaxy for scraps of Jedi knowledge the Empire tried to erase, gathering texts and relics he hopes will let him rebuild the order.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: The Cosmic Force falls quiet
events.note: The span runs until the Force stirs again around the Starkiller Incident.
events.summary: Once the Galactic Civil War ends, the Cosmic Force lies dormant, barely sensed even by those attuned to it. It stirs again in 34 ABY, when latent gifts such as Rey's and Finn's begin to wake.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: New separatists rise as Senate moves
events.summary: Eleven months after Endor, the New Republic skirmishes on its borders with the breakaway New Separatist Union as a Confederacy of Corporate Systems also forms. Mon Mothma's government prepares to shift its seat from Chandrila to farming world Nakadia.
sources: Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

events.title: Jakku orphans trained as child soldiers
events.note: Set just before the Battle of Jakku (5 ABY).
events.summary: Before the final battle, Gallius Rax gathers about two dozen Jakku orphans and puts them under young Armitage Hux, who drills them as the first of a new breed of stormtroopers, a model the First Order will follow.

events.title: Battle of Jakku: the Empire's last stand
events.summary: Just over a year after Endor, the New Republic fleet confronts most of what remains of the Imperial Navy over Jakku. Commodore Agate's Starhawk drags the dreadnought Ravager down into the desert, and the Empire's last great fleet is broken.

events.title: Keize dies trying to bury Imperial crimes
events.summary: During the Jakku battle, Colonel Soran Keize of Shadow Wing dives on Coruscant to collapse a hidden databank of Imperial atrocities, the archive feeding Cinder's orders. His former pilot Yrica Quell stops him, and Keize dies of his wounds.
sources: Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

events.title: Sloane kills Rax and flees beyond the map
events.summary: Joined by Norra and Brentin Wexley, Rae Sloane corners Rax at the observatory on Jakku before he can blow open the planet's core, and stabs him. At his dying urging she flees with Brendol Hux to meet the Emperor's ship Eclipse beyond known space.

events.title: Galactic Concordance ends the war
events.summary: After Jakku, Mas Amedda, the Empire's grand vizier, puts his name to the Galactic Concordance alongside Chancellor Mon Mothma on Chandrila. The Empire surrenders and the war officially ends; Amedda keeps a figurehead post on Coruscant, and Leia goes into labor at the ceremony.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Luke uncovers Jocasta Nu's hidden school
events.summary: Luke finds the buried refuge where Jedi archivist Jocasta Nu, after Order 66, stored holocrons of her teachings on a remote world. Its recovered knowledge feeds his effort to revive the Jedi.

events.title: Fenril sector breaks with the New Republic
events.note: Marvel's Star Wars (2025) is set about two years after Return of the Jedi.
events.summary: Pirates gut Republic convoys near Sullust, and Kezrin Almovar, Prime Minister of Pirros, throws the New Republic out of a trade summit, cutting the Fenril sector off. Behind the crisis stands the Anzati mystic Reyna Oskure.

events.title: Nagai revolt frees Nagi
events.summary: Enslaved Nagai rise up on Kaltrais with help from Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Rynn Zenat, seize ships, and carry the fight home to Nagi. The crisis ends with Nagi free and its people allied to the New Republic.

events.title: Han and Lando stop a droid-revolt plot
events.summary: Han and Lando Calrissian race to find a device called the Phylanx Redux Transmitter, which can make droids murder organics, before its maker Fyzen Gor unleashes it on Cloud City. Han kills Gor and the transmitter is destroyed.
events.wp: Search for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter

events.title: Morgan Elsbeth has a Republic envoy killed
events.note: Falls during Elsbeth's rule of Calodan, which began no earlier than 7 ABY and ended with its liberation in 9 ABY; placed mid-range.
events.summary: New Republic ambassador Nadura comes to Calodan on Corvus to bring the world into the Republic. Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth refuses, her guards cut down the escort, and the fleeing envoy dies when her ship is blown apart.

events.title: Shara Bey teaches young Poe to fly
events.note: Poe was six, per The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary.
events.summary: On Yavin 4, retired rebel pilot Shara Bey sits six-year-old Poe Dameron in her lap and lets him work the controls of her old A-wing, the start of a life spent flying.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Din Djarin claims the bounty on Grogu
events.summary: An Imperial remnant hires hunters to fetch a Force-sensitive infant of Yoda's species. The Mandalorian Din Djarin reaches him first on Arvala-7, shooting the rival droid IG-11 to keep the child alive, and begins the bond that will make Grogu his son.

events.title: Din Djarin takes Grogu back from the Client
events.summary: After handing the child to the Client on Nevarro for a hoard of beskar, Din has second thoughts and snatches him back, breaking the Bounty Hunters' Guild code. Nevarro's Mandalorian covert fights off the hunters to cover his escape.

events.title: Din's allies drive Gideon from Nevarro City
events.summary: Din, Cara Dune, Greef Karga, Kuiil and a rebuilt IG-11 fight Moff Gideon's troops in Nevarro City. Kuiil is killed, IG-11 destroys himself to save Grogu, and Gideon crawls from his downed fighter holding the Darksaber.

events.title: Din Djarin meets Bo-Katan's Nite Owls
events.summary: On Trask, Din learns that not all Mandalorians share his covert's creed when the Nite Owls under Bo-Katan Kryze save him. After raiding an Imperial freighter together, she sends him to find the Jedi Ahsoka Tano on Corvus.

events.title: Ahsoka Tano frees Calodan and names Grogu
events.summary: Ahsoka Tano and Din Djarin topple Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth's rule over Calodan on Corvus. Ahsoka learns the child's name is Grogu but declines to train him, and demands that Elsbeth reveal where Grand Admiral Thrawn is hiding.

events.title: Dark troopers seize Grogu on Tython
events.summary: Grogu reaches out through the Force from a seeing stone on Tython. Boba Fett, with Fennec Shand, arrives to reclaim his armor and helps defend him, but Gideon's dark troopers carry the child off and the Razor Crest is blown up.

events.title: Luke Skywalker takes Grogu for training
events.summary: Din's strike team storms Moff Gideon's cruiser; Din beats Gideon, wins the Darksaber, and takes him prisoner. When dark troopers close in, Luke Skywalker cuts through them, and Din takes off his helmet to bid Grogu farewell as the child leaves with the Jedi.

events.title: Four At Attin children escape the Barrier
events.note: Lucasfilm places Skeleton Crew in the same timeframe as The Mandalorian and Ahsoka; its order within 9 ABY is not established.
events.summary: Fern, KB, Wim and Neel, children of the sealed-off world At Attin, stumble on a buried starship and blast past the Barrier into the lawless galaxy, where they fall in with the scheming Force-user Jod Na Nawood.
sources: This Could Be a Real Adventure
Way, Way Out Past the Barrier

events.title: Pirates invade At Attin
events.note: Lucasfilm places Skeleton Crew in the same timeframe as The Mandalorian and Ahsoka; its order within 9 ABY is not established.
events.summary: Jod Na Nawood, the pirate captain Silvo, wins back his crew from the mutineer Brutus and uses the children's ship to pass At Attin's Barrier and loot its mint. The kids and their parents fight back, the Barrier falls, and New Republic fighters arrive.
sources: We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble

events.title: Boba Fett seizes Jabba's old palace
events.summary: Boba Fett storms Jabba's palace on Tatooine with Fennec Shand, kills the usurper Bib Fortuna, and takes the throne. Styling himself daimyo, he tries to rule Jabba's former territory with respect rather than fear.
sources: Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land

events.title: The Armorer casts out Din Djarin
events.summary: Paz Vizsla challenges Din for the Darksaber in the covert hidden on Glavis Ringworld. Learning that Din has shown his face, the Armorer declares him an apostate, outside the Creed, and sends him away.

events.title: Grogu leaves Luke's academy for Din
events.note: The temple's world, unnamed on screen, is identified as Ossus by Shadow of the Sith.
events.summary: On Ossus, where Luke is raising his first temple, Grogu trains in the Force. Offered Yoda's lightsaber or the beskar mail Din sent him, he chooses the armor, gives up Jedi training, and rejoins Din on Tatooine.
sources: Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger
Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor

events.title: Boba Fett's gotra beats the Pykes
events.summary: After the Pyke Syndicate bombs the Sanctuary cantina, Fett's gotra, Freetown's militia and Din Djarin fight the Pykes and the crime families backing them through Mos Espa. Fett kills Cad Bane, Fennec Shand wipes out the Pyke bosses, and Fett holds Tatooine.
sources: Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger
Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor

events.title: Din bathes in Mandalore's Living Waters
events.note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
events.summary: Seeking redemption, Din descends into the ruins of Mandalore and, guided by Bo-Katan Kryze, immerses himself in the Living Waters, proving the world can still support life. Pulling him from the depths, Bo-Katan glimpses a living mythosaur.

events.title: Penn Pershing's rehabilitation goes wrong
events.note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
events.summary: On Coruscant the New Republic's Amnesty Program houses former Imperials like cloning scientist Penn Pershing. When he tries to resume his research, Republic troops arrest him, and fellow Amnesty officer Elia Kane, secretly loyal to Gideon, wipes his mind.

events.title: Mandalorians free Nevarro from pirates
events.note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
events.summary: When the New Republic won't defend Nevarro from Gorian Shard's pirates, Bo-Katan leads the Tribe's warriors to retake the city. Shard dies with his flagship, and the Armorer charges Bo-Katan with reuniting all Mandalorians.

events.title: The Imperial Shadow Council meets in secret
events.note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
events.summary: Escaped from Republic custody, Moff Gideon meets the warlords of a revived Shadow Council, among them Gilad Pellaeon and Brendol Hux. They squabble over resources as Hux touts Project Necromancer and Pellaeon hints at Thrawn's return.

events.title: Mandalorians retake Mandalore from Gideon
events.note: Placed in 9 ABY by ordering: after Mandalorian Season Two (9 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) and before Ahsoka's 'Part Seven', which Star Wars Insider 228 sets nine years after A New Hope.
events.summary: Bo-Katan's reunited Mandalorians land on their homeworld, join survivors of the Purge and storm Gideon's hidden base. Gideon dies with his clones, the Great Forge burns again, and Din formally adopts his foundling as Din Grogu.

events.title: Ahsoka races Elsbeth for the map to Thrawn
events.note: Star Wars Insider 228 sets 'Part Seven' nine years after A New Hope; the season follows The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY).
events.summary: The Dark Jedi Shin Hati and her master Baylan Skoll free Morgan Elsbeth from Republic custody, destroying the cruiser Vesper. Ahsoka Tano recovers a star map to Thrawn's place of exile from Arcana, but Shin steals it on Lothal after wounding Sabine Wren.

events.title: The Eye of Sion jumps to another galaxy
events.note: Star Wars Insider 228 sets 'Part Seven' nine years after A New Hope; the season follows The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY).
events.summary: At Seatos, Elsbeth's hyperspace ring carries her, Baylan, Shin and Sabine Wren, who bargains her way aboard to reach Ezra, to Peridea in a distant galaxy. Ahsoka, knocked from a cliff, meets Anakin's spirit in a realm between worlds, then follows on a purrgil.

events.title: Grand Admiral Thrawn escapes exile
events.note: Star Wars Insider 228 sets 'Part Seven' nine years after A New Hope; the season follows The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY).
events.summary: On Peridea, Thrawn outwits Ahsoka's party and departs aided by the Nightsister Great Mothers, emerging at Dathomir with his Star Destroyer. Morgan Elsbeth falls to Ahsoka and Ezra Bridger gets home, but Ahsoka and Sabine are stranded.
sources: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord

events.title: Shara Bey dies on Yavin 4
events.summary: Bloodburn kills rebel veteran Shara Bey at the family home on Yavin 4, leaving her husband Kes and eight-year-old Poe. Leia sends the Damerons a letter promising that Shara will be remembered.

events.title: Finn is born
events.summary: The boy the First Order will seize as a toddler, number FN-2187 and train as a stormtrooper, is born. Years later Poe Dameron will give him the name Finn.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Spice Runners kill the Trune family
events.summary: Fleeing Republic patrols, a Spice Runners of Kijimi crew led by the Klatooinian Vigilch holes up on a Yungbrii farm and uses its family as shields. The shootout kills Sela Trune's family, and she later hunts the gang as a Republic security officer.

events.title: Imperial holdouts start stealing children
events.note: Finn's abduction is dated from his age (taken at three, 23 in 34 ABY). The First Order was formally organized only in 21 ABY, so these raids are credited to its emerging Imperial core.
events.summary: The Imperial forces that will become the First Order begin kidnapping children to raise as soldiers. Three-year-old Finn is taken in 14 ABY; in 15 ABY they seize two-year-old Kadara, Lando Calrissian's daughter, among other rebel leaders' children.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition

events.title: Din Djarin smashes Barro's Imperial remnant
events.note: The film's official podcast sets it about ten years after Return of the Jedi (4 ABY).
events.summary: Now hunting Imperial warlords under Republic contract, Din and Grogu hit Commander Barro's base on icy Phostera and wreck his AT-AT column. Barro dies fleeing, a costly win: the Republic wanted him alive to expose his fellow warlords.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

events.title: Din unmasks and captures Janu Coin
events.note: The film's official podcast sets it about ten years after Return of the Jedi (4 ABY).
events.summary: Colonel Ward sends Din to recover Jabba's son Rotta, a gladiator on the moon Shakari, for the Hutt Twins. Din discovers that Janu, the moon's crime boss, is the Imperial warlord Coin, captures him, and hides Rotta instead of delivering him.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

events.title: The Hutt Twins fall on Nal Hutta
events.note: The film's official podcast sets it about ten years after Return of the Jedi (4 ABY).
events.summary: The bounty hunter Embo abducts Din for the vengeful Hutt Twins. Grogu and a crew of Anzellan droidsmiths free him; Din storms the Twins' palace, the Twins die, Republic fighters level it, and Rotta chooses to side with the New Republic.
sources: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

events.title: Luke Skywalker restores the Jedi Order
events.note: Dated 19 years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary; Luke was already building his temple and training Grogu by 9 ABY.
events.summary: From his temple on Ossus, Luke formally revives the Jedi Order and gathers a new class of students. Among them is his nephew Ben Solo, sent by Leia and Han to learn to master his formidable strength in the Force.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Rey is born on Hyperkarn
events.summary: Rey is born on Hyperkarn to Miramir and Dathan, a powerless clone grown from Emperor Palpatine's genetic template. Her parents live in hiding from the Sith cult that made him.

events.title: Ben Solo's rivalry with Voe flares
events.summary: At Luke's academy on Ossus, the gifted Ben Solo spars with fellow student Voe, who resents how easily the Force comes to him. Friction among Luke's apprentices foreshadows the night the academy falls.

events.title: Poe Dameron joins the Spice Runners
events.summary: Restless teenager Poe Dameron flies a stranded Spice Runners of Kijimi crew off Yavin 4 and signs on as their pilot, falling for Zorii Bliss, daughter of the gang's ruthless leader Zeva.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Luke and Ben meet the Knights of Ren
events.note: Skywalker: A Family at War places it in the year Ben turned fourteen.
events.summary: Luke, his apprentice Ben Solo and explorer Lor San Tekka search an old Jedi outpost on Elphrona for relics and run into the Knights of Ren, while Snoke, already whispering in Ben's mind, deepens the boy's doubts about his uncle and the Jedi.

events.title: Poe defies Zeva Bliss at the Kijimi summit
events.summary: Zeva Bliss lures underworld rivals to Kijimi to massacre them. Poe refuses to spring her trap, helps the guests escape, and survives a fight with Zeva only because Zorii stops her; he then quits the gang and heads home.
events.conflict: Poe Dameron: Free Fall, which Star Wars: Timelines dates to 18-19 ABY, has Poe quit the Spice Runners after this summit; The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary dates his departure to eleven years before the Starkiller Incident, i.e. 23 ABY.

events.title: Rey is left on Jakku; her parents die
events.summary: To hide their daughter from Palpatine's cult, Dathan and Miramir leave the young Rey on Jakku in the care of the scrap dealer Unkar Plutt. The Sith assassin Ochi of Bestoon catches them soon after and kills them.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Luke and Lando chase Ochi to Pasaana
events.summary: Sensing a tremor in the Force and chasing leads toward the Sith world Exegol, Luke and Lando Calrissian track Ochi to Pasaana but never catch him; the assassin dies stranded there. Lando stays behind among the desert's Aki-Aki.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: The First Order takes shape in secret
events.note: Star Wars: Timelines dates its formation to 21 ABY; it went public with the Centrist secession of 29 ABY.
events.summary: Far beyond Republic space, the scattered Imperial remnant regroups as the First Order, led early on by Rae Sloane and Brendol Hux, and quietly builds a new navy and army. The mysterious Snoke will rise to rule it as Supreme Leader.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: First Order secretly bankrolls its rearmament
events.summary: For seven years the First Order funnels money through Rinnrivin Di's smuggling and gambling cartel to arm the Amaxine warriors and build its navy. Leia exposes the scheme in 28 ABY and wrecks the Amaxine base on Sibensko, where Di dies.

events.title: Brendol Hux recruits Phasma on Parnassos
events.summary: Crash-landed on the harsh world Parnassos in the late Emperor's yacht, Brendol Hux is guided to safety by the Scyre fighter Phasma, who sells out her own clan to win a post with the First Order. She soon helps train its stormtroopers.

events.title: Amaxine terror strikes the Senate
events.summary: Secretly serving the First Order, Senator Carise Sindian has Amaxine militants bomb a Senate building on Hosnian Prime as a diversion. Soon after, Amaxine leader Arliz Hadrassian shoots Populist champion Tai-Lin Garr, then herself.

events.title: Vader revealed as Leia's father
events.summary: Manipulated by Carise Sindian, Centrist senator Ransolm Casterfo tells the Senate that Leia Organa is Darth Vader's daughter. The scandal wrecks her bid to become First Senator, and she leaves the Senate soon after.

events.title: Leia Organa founds the Resistance
events.summary: Out of the Senate and sure the First Order is real, Leia begins gathering trusted pilots and old rebel allies into a private force to watch it. The Resistance works outside the Republic's reluctant military.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
events.conflict: Bloodline (28 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines) ends with Leia starting to build the Resistance, while The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary dates its formation to five years before the Starkiller Incident (29 ABY); Wookieepedia reads 29 ABY as the year it became operational.

events.title: Ben Solo destroys Luke's Jedi academy
events.note: Dated six years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
events.summary: Sensing Snoke's hold on Ben, Luke ignites his lightsaber over his sleeping nephew for one fatal instant. Ben wakes, the academy burns, and most students die. As Kylo Ren he seizes leadership of Ren's knights and hunts down those who pursue him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
events.conflict: The Last Jedi gives rival accounts of that night: Luke first says Ben simply turned on him, then admits he briefly ignited his lightsaber over his sleeping nephew, while Ben tells it as an attempt on his life.

events.title: Luke vanishes into exile on Ahch-To
events.note: Follows the academy's destruction, dated 28 ABY.
events.summary: Blaming himself for Ben's fall, Luke disappears. He retreats to Ahch-To, where the first Jedi temple stands, shuts out the Force, and leaves behind only a star map fragment pointing the way.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: First Order secession opens the Cold War
events.note: Dated five years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary; the Cold War lasts until the Hosnian Cataclysm.
events.summary: Centrist worlds such as Arkanis and Kuat quit the New Republic and openly side with the First Order. A tense standoff follows: the Order probes Republic borders and flouts the Concordance while a complacent Senate refuses to answer with force.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

events.title: Leia begins searching for Luke
events.note: Dated five years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
events.summary: As the First Order grows bolder, Leia starts hunting for her missing brother, hoping a returned Jedi can turn the tide. R2-D2, idle since his master left, powers down into low-power mode.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Phasma poisons Brendol Hux
events.summary: In league with his son Armitage, Captain Phasma kills Brendol Hux with the venom of a Parnassos beetle and hides the cause of his death. Armitage inherits his father's standing in the First Order.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Poe Dameron defects to the Resistance
events.note: Dated three years before the Starkiller Incident by The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary.
events.summary: After his Rapier Squadron clashes with First Order TIEs hijacking a freighter at Suraz 4, Republic commander Poe Dameron defies orders to chase the stolen ship. Leia takes notice, and Poe, his wingmates and BB-8 join the Resistance.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Pirates find clone trooper Kix frozen alive
events.summary: Rival pirate captains Sidon Ithano and Scorza race for 'Count Dooku's treasure' in a wrecked Separatist warship on Ponemah Terminal. The prize is Kix, a clone medic kept in stasis since he uncovered Order 66; he joins Ithano's crew.
sources: The Crimson Corsair and the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku

events.title: Gannis Ducain steals the Millennium Falcon
events.note: Placed after the Kix story and before Life Day 1, which Star Wars: Timelines dates to c. 31 ABY.
events.summary: Han Solo loses his Millennium Falcon to a thief, Gannis Ducain. Passed from thief to thief, the freighter ends up in junk boss Unkar Plutt's hands on Jakku, where it sits unused for years.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Flight of the Falcon, Part 5: Grand Theft Falcon

events.title: Black Squadron hunts for Lor San Tekka
events.note: Poe began leading Black Squadron two years before the Starkiller Incident; the hunt ends at Tuanul.
events.summary: Leia sends Poe Dameron's new Black Squadron after Lor San Tekka, an aging explorer who might know where Luke is. First Order agent Terex dogs them from world to world until the trail ends at Tuanul on Jakku.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Lanever Villecham becomes Chancellor
events.summary: The Senate elects Tarsunt's Lanever Villecham as Chancellor. A firm believer in the peace that followed the Concordance, he leads a Republic unwilling to treat the First Order as a real threat.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Poe recruits Kazuda Xiono as a spy
events.summary: Republic pilot Kazuda Xiono survives a First Order ambush alongside Poe Dameron and is recruited on the spot. Poe plants him as a mechanic on the Colossus, an ocean refueling platform on Castilon, to watch for First Order activity.
events.wp: Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance

events.title: The First Order occupies the Colossus
events.summary: After pirates kidnap his daughter Torra, Captain Imanuel Doza lets the First Order garrison the Colossus. Kaz and his friends go underground and rally the platform's people into their own resistance cell.

events.title: First Order massacres Tuanul
events.summary: Hunting the map to Luke, Kylo Ren's troops raze Tuanul, a village on Jakku. Kylo kills Lor San Tekka and seizes Poe Dameron, but BB-8 rolls off into the desert with the map hidden inside.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: FN-2187 defects and frees Poe
events.summary: Sickened by the Tuanul massacre, stormtrooper FN-2187 breaks Poe Dameron out of the Star Destroyer Finalizer, and the two escape in a hijacked TIE fighter. Poe names him Finn; they crash on Jakku and lose each other in the wreck.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: Rey and Finn flee Jakku in the Falcon
events.summary: Scavenger Rey flees a First Order strike on Niima Outpost with Finn and BB-8 aboard the junked Millennium Falcon. Han Solo and Chewbacca reclaim their old ship in space and agree to help carry the map.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: Starkiller Base destroys the Hosnian system
events.summary: Fired from the converted planet Ilum, Starkiller Base's beam crosses the galaxy and annihilates the Hosnian system, killing the Senate at the capital, Hosnian Prime, and much of the Republic fleet. The Cold War becomes open war.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: The Colossus breaks free into hyperspace
events.summary: As the Hosnian system burns, Kaz, Captain Doza and Jarek Yeager drive the First Order off the Colossus and fire up its long-dead engines, taking the whole platform into hyperspace. Kaz's friend Tam Ryvora stays behind and joins the Order.

events.title: First Order levels Maz Kanata's castle
events.summary: Tipped off that BB-8 is on Takodana, the First Order razes Maz Kanata's castle. Rey, who has just found Luke's old lightsaber there, is captured by Kylo Ren before Resistance X-wings drive the attackers off.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: Resistance destroys Starkiller Base
events.summary: The Resistance strikes Starkiller Base before it can fire on D'Qar, and Poe's X-wings blow it apart. Inside, Kylo Ren kills his father Han Solo; Rey, her Force strength awakened, defeats Kylo in the snow.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

events.title: Iden Versio dies avenging Del Meeko
events.summary: Former Imperial commando Iden Versio, her daughter Zay and Shriv Suurgav board the Star Destroyer Retribution to punish Gideon Hask for executing Del Meeko. Iden and Hask both die, but the team escapes with First Order intelligence.

events.title: Rey finds Luke Skywalker on Ahch-To
events.summary: With R2-D2's data completing the map, Rey and Chewbacca fly to Ahch-To and offer Luke his old lightsaber. Luke, shut off from the Force, refuses to return but grudgingly gives Rey three lessons before she leaves to reach Kylo Ren.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: Resistance flees D'Qar at heavy cost
events.summary: As the First Order fleet arrives over D'Qar, Poe Dameron's defiant attack opens a path for Resistance bombers, and Paige Tico drops the payload that destroys the dreadnought Fulminatrix. Every bomber is lost, and Leia demotes Poe.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: First Order ambushes the fleeing Resistance
events.summary: Using new hyperspace tracking, the First Order catches the Resistance fleet. A strike on the Raddus kills Admiral Ackbar and most of the command staff; Leia survives the vacuum through the Force, and Vice Admiral Holdo assumes command.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: Finn and Rose seek a codebreaker
events.summary: Hoping to disable the tracker, Finn and Rose Tico fly to Canto Bight, a gambling resort on Cantonica, free a herd of fathiers, and hire the slicer DJ, who later sells them out to the First Order.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: Kylo Ren kills Supreme Leader Snoke
events.summary: Brought before Snoke aboard the Supremacy, Rey watches Kylo Ren cut his master in half. Together they kill the Praetorian Guards, but Rey refuses to rule beside him, and Kylo names himself Supreme Leader.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: Holdo rams the Supremacy at lightspeed
events.summary: To shield the escaping transports, Vice Admiral Holdo turns the Raddus and jumps to lightspeed straight through the Supremacy, splitting Snoke's flagship and crippling much of the fleet around it.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: Luke's last stand at Crait
events.summary: The First Order besieges the surviving Resistance fighters in an old rebel base on Crait. Luke, projecting his image from distant Ahch-To, faces Kylo Ren, buying time for them to flee on the Falcon, then passes peacefully into the Force.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

events.title: The Resistance rebuilds after Crait
events.summary: From a cave base on Ryloth, the survivors rally old rebels such as Norra Wexley and Wedge Antilles, free Ransolm Casterfo on Corellia, and gather ships. A First Order raid forces them to abandon Ryloth and scatter to new hideouts.

events.title: Kylo Ren retraces Darth Vader's past
events.note: Set after The Last Jedi and before the Battle of Batuu, both dated 34 ABY by Star Wars: Timelines.
events.summary: Now Supreme Leader, Kylo Ren chases his grandfather's history from Vader's fortress on Mustafar to Tatooine and Naboo. On Naboo he secretly stokes the rebellion his troops then fight; when Vader's former aide Vaneé exposes this, he withdraws and has the rebels wiped out.

events.title: Hux annihilates Tah'Nuhna
events.summary: As punishment for supplying the Resistance, General Hux's forces aboard the Finalizer lay waste to Tah'Nuhna, with TIE bombers flattening its capital and seat of government.

events.title: The Colossus destroys the Thunderer
events.summary: Horrified when the First Order bombs Aeos Prime for sheltering the Colossus, Tam Ryvora defects. Kaz's team knocks out the Star Destroyer Thunderer's shields, Jade and Ace Squadrons destroy it with Commander Pyre aboard, and Kylo Ren executes Agent Tierny.

events.title: Resistance and First Order clash on Batuu
events.note: Four to six months after the Hosnian Cataclysm.
events.summary: Some months after Hosnian Prime's destruction, Vi Moradi and the ex-trooper Archex found a Resistance cell at Black Spire Outpost. Then the Order's 709th Legion seizes the town, and the Finalizer is crippled overhead, sending Kylo Ren to the Steadfast.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: First Order fails to take Coruscant
events.note: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire places it during the First Order-Resistance War (34-35 ABY per Star Wars: Timelines); the exact date is unknown.
events.summary: The First Order sends at least two large task forces to seize Coruscant, the old Imperial capital, and is beaten back. The failed push stays murky; historian Beaumont Kin later cites a First Order file about it.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

events.title: Palpatine's voice promises revenge
events.summary: A transmission in the voice of the long-dead Emperor Palpatine spreads across the galaxy, vowing revenge. Its source is Exegol, the Sith Eternal's secret world, and it sends both Kylo Ren and the Resistance hunting for the truth.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Kylo Ren finds Sidious alive on Exegol
events.summary: Following a Sith wayfinder from Vader's castle on Mustafar, Kylo Ren reaches Exegol and finds a revived Darth Sidious. The Emperor claims he made Snoke and offers Kylo the Final Order, a fleet of planet-killing Star Destroyers, if he kills Rey.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Rey's team follows Ochi's trail to Pasaana
events.summary: Following Luke's notes, Rey, Poe and Finn reach Pasaana, with Chewbacca and two droids, during its Festival of the Ancestors. With Lando's help they find Ochi's ship and dagger, but the First Order seizes Chewbacca, whom they believe killed.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Hux is exposed as the Resistance spy
events.summary: On Kijimi the team pulls a Sith translation from C-3PO's memory, then raids the Steadfast to rescue Chewbacca, where Kylo tells Rey she is Palpatine's granddaughter. General Hux reveals he is their spy; Allegiant General Pryde shoots him and takes command.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Leia dies and Ben Solo returns
events.summary: Rey recovers the Emperor's wayfinder from the Death Star wreck on Kef Bir, but Kylo crushes it and they duel on the ruins. Leia spends her last strength reaching her son and dies; Rey heals Kylo, and Ben Solo turns back to the light.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: The Final Order destroys Kijimi
events.summary: To prove the First Order's loyalty to Sidious, Allegiant General Pryde has the Final Order destroyer Derriphan turn its planet-cracking cannon on Kijimi, wiping out the world.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Battle of Exegol ends the Sith
events.summary: Lando and Chewbacca lead a citizens' fleet to Exegol and break the Final Order. Below, Rey and Ben Solo face Sidious; Rey turns his lightning back and destroys him, dies, and is revived by Ben, who then fades into the Force.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: The galaxy rises against the First Order
events.summary: News from Exegol sparks revolts on Endor, Bespin, Naboo, Jakku, Lothal and other occupied worlds, toppling First Order control, while the Resistance celebrates and mourns at its base on Ajan Kloss.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel

events.title: Rey takes the Skywalker name
events.summary: Rey travels to Tatooine and the deserted Lars homestead, buries Luke's and Leia's lightsabers, and ignites her own new yellow blade. When a passerby asks her name, she answers 'Rey Skywalker' as the twins' spirits look on.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition

events.title: Beaumont Kin excavates the Sith Citadel
events.summary: Months after the battle, Resistance historian Beaumont Kin leads a dig through Exegol's Sith Citadel. Scrolls and relics found there expose Palpatine's Sith lineage, including his master Darth Plagueis, and feed Kin's history of the Empire.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

events.title: Rey Skywalker rebuilds the Jedi Order
events.note: From an announced, unreleased film; Kathleen Kennedy (Star Wars Celebration 2023) set it about fifteen years after The Rise of Skywalker.
events.summary: Some fifteen years after Exegol, Jedi Master Rey Skywalker sets about building a new Jedi Order, the story of a film Lucasfilm has announced but not yet released.

events.title: A Whill begins writing Episode IV
events.yText: long after the Battle of Yavin (undated)
events.note: Undated ('a long time after the Battle of Yavin'); placed just after the last dated entry (c. 50 ABY) only so it sorts at the end of the timeline.
events.summary: Long after these events, one of the Whills is asked to set the galaxy's history down in the Whills' journal for readers far away. The Whill starts with 'Episode IV', while a fussier colleague writes about a Wookiee family's Life Day.
events.tText: long after the Battle of Yavin (undated)

events.title: The Graf Archive publishes the Galactic Atlas
events.yText: long after the Battle of Yavin (undated)
events.note: Undated ('a long time after the Battle of Yavin'); placed just after the last dated entry (c. 50 ABY) only so it sorts at the end of the timeline.
events.summary: Maps drawn by the artist Gammit Chond from stories of the galaxy sit forgotten in the Graf Archive's Shadow Stacks until a trainee archivist unearths them. The archive publishes them as the Galactic Atlas, later expanded with newfound notes.
sources: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition
events.tText: long after the Battle of Yavin (undated)

visions.title: The sacred Jedi texts pass to Rey

legs.note: Books from the Order's dawn, gathered by Luke in the Ahch-To tree, are taken by Rey.
Rey studies them at the Resistance base, relearning forgotten techniques.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
visions.summary: Eight books and scrolls from the Jedi Order's earliest days sit in a hollow tree on Ahch-To, collected by Luke. When Yoda's lightning burns the tree, Rey has already hidden them aboard the Falcon, and she later pores over them to recover lost skills.
visions.note: Dated from the Rammahgon, whose original was lost over five millennia before 35 ABY; the collection may be older.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

visions.title: Darth Momin is reborn on Mustafar

legs.note: Bodiless for a millennium in his mask, Momin uses Vader's fortress to rebuild himself, then dies again.

visions.summary: Destroyed by his own city-killing weapon a millennium earlier, Momin lives on as a mind in his mask. Given to Vader, the mask shapes Fortress Vader into a gateway of dark power, and Momin uses it to regain a body before Vader kills him once more.
visions.note: Star Wars: Timelines dates his first death to c. 1100–1000 BBY; 1050 is a placeholder midpoint.

visions.title: Santari Khri's message waits two centuries

legs.note: Dagan watches her recording in the observatory; Cal's crew finds the full version and its route.

visions.summary: Having sealed Dagan Gera in bacta rather than kill him, Santari Khri left a message for his waking: seek her out, or keep chasing Tanalorr. Two hundred years later he watches part of it before his last duel, and Cal's crew uses the rest to chart a route to Tanalorr.
visions.note: Recording date follows Dagan's stasis count (224 years before 9 BBY).

visions.title: Qui-Gon's likeness appears on Mortis

legs.note: Twelve years after Naboo, Qui-Gon warns Obi-Wan the planet may corrupt an unbalanced Anakin.
Later he sends Anakin to confront his demons in the planet's dark-side well.

visions.summary: Mortis magnifies the Force enough for Qui-Gon to stand before Obi-Wan and, later, Anakin. He says the realm will test whether Anakin can find balance. Back home Obi-Wan calls him an illusion drawn from their memories; Anakin is less sure.
visions.conflict: Wookieepedia's Qui-Gon article says it truly was him; the Force spirit article calls it a vision wrongly taken for a real manifestation; Obi-Wan tells the Council it was an illusion (Voices).

visions.title: Sifo-Dyas foresees a galactic war

legs.note: His warning is dismissed; the war begins at Geonosis a decade later, fought by his clones.

visions.summary: Before Naboo was invaded, Sifo-Dyas sensed a vast war ahead and pressed for a Republic army. The Council judged him extreme and removed him, yet he secretly ordered clones from Kamino. The war he saw began at Geonosis, fought by that army.
visions.note: The vision is only dated 'before the Invasion of Naboo'; he died in 32 BBY.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

visions.title: The Chosen One will bring balance

legs.note: Qui-Gon names Anakin the Chosen One; Anakin destroys Sidious above Endor's moon.
Obi-Wan cries that the Chosen One failed; Endor shows the prophecy delayed, not broken.
Anakin's voice urges Rey to restore balance, just as he had.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
visions.summary: An ancient Jedi prophecy, kept on a holocron, speaks of one born of the Force and destined to end the Sith. Qui-Gon finds Anakin on Tatooine and believes it. Anakin becomes a Sith instead, until at Endor he throws Sidious down a shaft to protect Luke.
visions.note: The prophecy's utterance is undated, so legs start at its recorded invocations.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
visions.conflict: Most sources credit Anakin at Endor, but Sidious returns in 35 ABY; art director Rick Carter credits Rey, Kenobi believes it is Luke (Twin Suns), and Lucas once suggested Leia.

visions.title: Qui-Gon's voice cries out to Anakin

legs.note: During the Tusken massacre Qui-Gon begs Anakin to stop; Yoda hears the cry on Coruscant.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
visions.summary: As Anakin slaughters the Tusken camp, Qui-Gon, ten years dead, calls his name and begs him to stop. Meditating on Coruscant, Yoda hears the cry and feels Anakin's pain without grasping it; Anakin tells himself he imagined it.
visions.note: Later canon identifies the voice as Qui-Gon's.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

visions.title: Qui-Gon's voice guides Yoda's last quest

legs.note: In the Temple, Qui-Gon lifts Yoda and nearby objects to prove he is there; Anakin hears him too.
On Dagobah he shows himself as a swarm of lights and sends Yoda to the Priestesses.

visions.summary: Late in the war Yoda hears Qui-Gon say he now belongs to the Living Force. The Council fears a Sith trick, but Yoda slips away to Dagobah, where Qui-Gon, still unable to take form, starts him toward keeping his identity after death.

visions.title: Qui-Gon finally appears to Obi-Wan

legs.note: A voice warns Obi-Wan that three-year-old Luke is in danger from raiders.
After facing Vader, Obi-Wan sees Qui-Gon near Beggar's Canyon, who says he was always there.
As Luke races home, Qui-Gon appears nearly solid and hints they will soon be together.

visions.summary: For a decade on Tatooine Obi-Wan calls to his old master without an answer he can trust. Only after he confronts Vader and accepts Anakin's fall does Qui-Gon stand before him in the desert. Tie-in stories add an earlier warning and a last visit before the Death Star.
sources: From a Certain Point of View
visions.conflict: Time of Death has Qui-Gon speak to Obi-Wan in 16 BBY; the Kenobi series shows him unreachable until 9 BBY. Author Cavan Scott (2026) was unsure whether it had been retconned.

visions.title: Generations of Jedi speak to Rey

legs.note: Qui-Gon: every past Jedi lives on inside her.
Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Adi Gallia and Luminara Unduli, all dead by the Purge.
Obi-Wan, heard in both his older and younger voice.
Kanan Jarrus tells her a Jedi's strength lies in the heart.
Anakin asks her to bring balance back, as he once had; Yoda says she was never alone.
Luke's voice closes the chorus with a blessing.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
visions.summary: Drained and beaten beneath Palpatine's citadel, Rey asks the Jedi to be with her. Voices from generations she knows only by name answer: Qui-Gon, Mace, Obi-Wan, Kanan, Ahsoka, Anakin, Yoda, Luke. Lifted by them, she stands and turns Palpatine's lightning back on him.
visions.note: Adi Gallia died in 19 BBY; Luminara Unduli between 19 and 18 BBY; both grouped at 19 BBY.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition
visions.conflict: Ahsoka Tano's voice is among them, though no canon source shows her death by 35 ABY; the Force spirit article also notes some speakers, like Mace Windu, were voices rather than full spirits.

visions.title: Sifo-Dyas's final message, found twice

legs.note: A signal from his downed shuttle leads Plo Koon to Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber.
Karr Nuq Sin digs up a holoprojector holding the Jedi's last message about the clones.

visions.summary: Shot down over a moon of Oba Diah, Sifo-Dyas left a wreck that kept signalling. Near the war's end it draws Plo Koon to his lightsaber, reopening the question of who ordered the clones; decades later a boy finds his recorded message buried in the sand.
visions.note: The site is a moon of Oba Diah; the planet stands in as place.

visions.title: Anakin dreams of his mother's pain

legs.note: The nightmares show Shmi in agony; he finds her dying, a Tusken captive.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
visions.summary: Guarding Padmé, Anakin keeps dreaming of his mother suffering. He leaves his post for Tatooine, learns Tusken Raiders seized her a month before, and reaches her just as her life ebbs away; the grief drives the slaughter that follows.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

visions.title: Shmi's apparition confronts Anakin's guilt

legs.note: Two years after Shmi's death on Tatooine, a figure of his mother comes to Anakin's room.

visions.summary: In the Father's monastery a figure of Shmi visits Anakin at night. He pours out his guilt over the Tusken killings and his hidden marriage; she tells him that guilt is tearing him in two, then twists into something monstrous and is gone.
visions.note: Whether this is Shmi or a Mortis illusion is left open.

visions.title: Ahsoka dreams of Padmé's assassin

legs.note: Dreams of Aurra Sing lead Ahsoka to a refugee summit on Alderaan, where Sing strikes.

visions.summary: Put on rest, Ahsoka keeps dreaming that the mercenary Aurra Sing is stalking someone close to her, and works out that the target is Padmé. She joins the senator's trip to Alderaan; the attack comes as foreseen, and Ahsoka keeps her alive.
visions.note: The attempt happens and Padmé is wounded, but the killing is prevented.

visions.title: The Son shows Anakin his future

legs.note: Jedi dying and a clash with Darth Sidious: the Order's end.
Betrayal on Mustafar, the turn that seals his life as Vader.
Alderaan blown apart by the Empire's first battle station.

visions.summary: Deep in the planet's dark-side well, the Son spreads Anakin's future before him: slain Jedi, a fight with Sidious, betrayal on Mustafar, a world blown apart. Horrified, Anakin sides with the Son to change it, until the Father wipes the memory and the future stands.
visions.note: Alderaan's destruction is dated 1 BBY by the updated Galactic Atlas.

visions.title: Ahsoka's older self warns her away

legs.note: Her adult self says staying Anakin's student may cost her a future; she leaves the Jedi in 19 BBY.

visions.summary: Sheltering on Mortis, Ahsoka is visited by a grown version of herself who says Anakin's darkness will corrupt her and urges her to leave him. Ahsoka defends her master. She does later leave the Order, and outlives his fall.
visions.note: No source ties the warning to a date; linking it to her departure in The Wrong Jedi is interpretive.

visions.title: The Father foretells balance for the galaxy

legs.note: Dying, the Father says Anakin balanced Mortis and will one day balance the whole galaxy.

visions.summary: Having turned the dagger on himself to drain the Son's borrowed power, the Father names Anakin the Chosen One: he restored balance on Mortis and will someday bring the whole galaxy into balance too; he must beware his own heart. Both halves come true.
visions.note: The episode gives no date; Endor as the fulfilment follows the Chosen One article.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: The Daughter gives Ahsoka her life

legs.note: Killed by the Son, Ahsoka revives as the dying Daughter channels her last strength into her.
Morai, a convor tied to the Daughter, guides Ezra to the door where Ahsoka is about to fall.
Morai still watches over Ahsoka on Peridea, a galaxy away.

visions.summary: Drained by the Son, Ahsoka lies dead until the stabbed Daughter, using Anakin as a conduit, pours what life she has left into her. Ahsoka wakes remembering nothing. The convor Morai, bound to the Daughter, keeps turning up at her side for decades.
visions.note: The Morai–Daughter link is speculation in-universe (Hydan), recorded as belief by Wookieepedia.
sources: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord

visions.title: Pong Krell foresees the Republic's fall

legs.note: Krell's vision of the Order destroyed and an Empire rising comes true within a year.

visions.summary: Exposed as a traitor on Umbara, Krell tells Rex he has seen the Jedi exterminated and the Republic torn apart from within and remade as an Empire; he sabotaged his own troops hoping to serve the coming order. The clones execute him, but his vision holds.
visions.note: The vision is described, not shown.

visions.title: Nightsister spirits claim a debt on Dathomir

legs.note: Spirits of Nightsisters, whose clan was massacred in the war, possess Kanan and Sabine.

visions.summary: Maul's borrowed Nightsister spell works, but the dead witches who fed it want flesh as payment. Two spirits rise from the altar and take over Kanan and Sabine. Ezra offers himself instead, then smashes the altar; the witches vanish screaming.
visions.note: Dark-side spirits, not Force spirits; the Nightsister massacre is dated 20 BBY (Massacre).

visions.title: Anakin's training holograms outlast his fall

legs.note: Ezra and Ahsoka study recordings of Anakin's saber lessons aboard Hera's ship.
Riding a purrgil between galaxies, Ahsoka spars against her master's hologram.

visions.summary: Anakin's recorded dueling lessons survive him. Ezra studies them to fight better, and Ahsoka, who has not seen her master in years, watches them in Kanan's cabin; a decade later she still trains against the hologram in deep space.
visions.note: The recordings are undated; in Part Seven Anakin names Grievous, Ventress and Dooku, placing them in the war.

visions.title: Yoda glimpses the Jedi's destruction on Dagobah

legs.note: Clones turn on Jedi and Sidious cuts down Jedi Masters, as happens at the war's end.

visions.summary: Sent by Qui-Gon's voice into a cave on Dagobah, Yoda is overwhelmed by images of clones fighting Jedi and a Sith Lord killing a group of Masters. He stumbles out shaken, sure the Sith plan is close but unable to say when.
visions.note: The same cave, later called the Cave of Evil, tests Luke in 3 ABY.

visions.title: The Force Priestesses foretell Yoda's destiny

legs.note: They accept Yoda because he will train someone vital to the galaxy: Luke.
They promise Qui-Gon will teach him to endure after death; he does so when he dies.

visions.summary: On the world where midi-chlorians arise, five masked Priestesses take Yoda on because he will one day teach someone crucial to the galaxy. After his final trial they add that Qui-Gon will teach him to live on after death. Both come to pass on Dagobah.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back
Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: Yoda hears his own last words

legs.note: He hears 'There is another Skywalker', which he will say to Luke while dying on Dagobah.

visions.summary: After passing the Priestesses' last trial, Yoda briefly sees ahead and hears himself speak of another Skywalker, the words he will give Luke twenty-three years later in his final moments on Dagobah.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: Bane's spectre and Sidious's illusion test Yoda

to.yText: a millennium before the Empire (c. 1019 BBY)
to.tText: a millennium before the Empire (c. 1019 BBY)

legs.note: Darth Bane's apparition, dead about a millennium, recounts devising the Rule of Two.
Sidious and Dooku project a false battle where Yoda can end the Sith by letting Anakin fall.

visions.summary: On Moraband, cradle of the Sith, Yoda meets the apparition of Darth Bane, then a false present conjured by Sidious in which he can destroy the Sith only by letting Anakin die. Yoda gives himself up to save Anakin, the illusion collapses, and the trial is passed.
visions.note: Bane's death is dated only as a millennium before the Empire, allegedly on Ambria.

visions.title: Talzin and the Frangawl prophecy

legs.note: The foretold vanishing of the Masters and queen is staged by the cult; Talzin's ritual is stopped.
The promised era of darkness arrives anyway when the Republic becomes the Empire.

visions.summary: Bardotta's queen warns that the vanishing of the Dagoyan Masters fulfils an old prophecy: lose the queen and darkness will spread through the galaxy. The prophecy came from the Frangawl Cult, who seize her so Mother Talzin can take her life force; Windu and Binks stop it.
visions.note: Reading the 'era of darkness' as the Empire is an inference, not stated in the episodes.

visions.title: Ventress chooses to return to life

legs.note: Laid in Dathomir's waters months after dying, she is offered a way back.
Mother Talzin, herself dead, speaks from beyond and names the price: her heart's desire.
Alive again, she resurfaces in the Empire's early years and meets the Bad Batch.

visions.summary: Killed saving Quinlan Vos, Ventress is carried home and laid to rest in her clan's sacred pools. There, dead, she hears Mother Talzin: Vos's love is a gift, and she may go back at the cost of what she most wants. She steps back into life and a quiet existence.

visions.title: Maul foresees Anakin as Sidious's apprentice

legs.note: Days later Anakin kneels to Sidious, as Maul warned during the siege.

visions.summary: Near the war's end Maul has seen that Sidious means to make Anakin his new apprentice. He lays a trap on Mandalore to kill Anakin and Kenobi before it can happen, and tells Ahsoka what is coming; she cannot act on it in time.

visions.title: Anakin foresees Padmé dying in childbirth

legs.note: The dream comes true on Polis Massa after the twins are born, brought on by his own choices.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
visions.summary: Anakin dreams that Padmé dies giving birth and swears to stop it at any cost. That fear carries him to Palpatine and darkness; on Mustafar he chokes her, and she dies on Polis Massa after the twins arrive. Fighting the vision fulfils it.
visions.note: frac values give relative order only.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

visions.title: Kenobi's warning to surviving Jedi

legs.note: Caleb Dume, bound for Coruscant through hyperspace, receives the warning and turns away.
Cere Junda saved the broadcast to a holocron; it plays during Cal Kestis's mission.
Ezra opens Kanan's holocron and hears the message; Kanan later plays it in full.
The holocron replays the warning in the night, starting Ezra's search for Kenobi.

visions.record: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion
visions.summary: In the fallen Temple, Obi-Wan and Yoda turn the recall beacon into a warning, and Obi-Wan records a message: the Order has fallen, stay away, trust the Force, a new hope will come. Survivors catch it that day, and holocron copies carry it to new Jedi years later.
visions.note: Episode III shows the beacon being changed; the recorded wording is heard in Rebels.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

visions.title: Eno Cordova foresees the Jedi Order's fall

legs.note: The Council ignores him; Order 66 proves him right.

visions.summary: Exploring a Zeffo temple, Cordova foresees the Jedi Order's end and hurries to warn the Council, which dismisses him. Only the archivist Jocasta Nu believes him, copying for him the holocron that names Force-sensitive children, which he hides on Bogano.
visions.note: The vision's year is not given beyond predating the Purge.

visions.title: Eno Cordova's recordings lead Cal on

legs.note: BD-1 plays Cordova's first message; later ones on Zeffo, Kashyyyk and Dathomir guide Cal.

visions.summary: Before the Purge, Eno Cordova hid a holocron naming Force-sensitive children inside a Zeffo vault and had BD-1 record messages about his journey, a trail of tests for whoever followed. Five years into the Empire, Cal traces them one by one.
visions.note: The recordings predate the Purge but carry no exact date; Cordova himself lived until 9 BBY.

visions.title: A holocron leads Luke to Elzar Mann

legs.note: A recorded Yoda in a Jedi holocron teaches Luke about visions and names Gazian.
The living planet kept Elzar Mann's mind as he was; the imprint talks with Luke.

visions.summary: A Yoda recording in a holocron sends Luke to Gazian, a living vergence. Trapped there, he meets the preserved mind of Elzar Mann, a Jedi of the Republic's golden era, who guesses he must be long dead and tells Luke the path is hard but worth it.
visions.note: Neither recording is dated; Elzar Mann flourished during the High Republic, c. 232 BBY onward.

visions.title: Cal's echoes of the Purge and Trilla's fall

legs.note: A flashback returns Cal to Order 66, when Master Jaro Tapal died shielding him.
Holding Trilla's lightsaber, Cal sees her tortured until she becomes the Second Sister.
At the vault he sees the younglings he might gather being hunted; he later destroys the holocron.

visions.summary: Cal can read the past in objects. On Dathomir he relives the day clones killed his master and faces Tapal's spirit underground; at the Bogano vault, Trilla's saber shows how torture remade her, and another vision shows what gathering the listed children would cost.
visions.note: Tapal died aboard the Albedo Brave in the Bracca system. 'No' refers to the averted future vision.

visions.title: Vader walks Momin's portal through his life

legs.note: His pregnant mother, and Sidious hinted as the hand behind his conception.
Doorways onto his podracing days and first moments with Padmé and Obi-Wan.
A glimpse ahead to his duel with Ahsoka on Malachor.
Cutting down phantom Jedi, he hears his grandson's voice: let the past die.

visions.summary: After killing Darth Momin, Vader walks through the Sith's dark side gateway hoping to bring Padmé back. He drifts past scenes of his life and ahead to Malachor, slays phantom Jedi as Kylo Ren's words sound, loses Padmé again, and a vision of Luke casts him out.
visions.note: Timelines places the issue in 12 BBY; sources call it a dark side portal, not the World Between Worlds.

visions.title: Maul faces phantoms in a Sith castle

legs.note: A phantom Qui-Gon, whom Maul killed, offers him freedom from the past; Maul attacks.
A phantom Grievous mocks him over the killing of Mother Talzin.
A phantom Savage Opress calls Maul's drive weakness, not vengeance.

visions.summary: Hunting for power after the Republic's fall, Maul enters a Sith castle that raises figures from his past: his brother Savage, the cyborg who killed his mother, and Qui-Gon offering release from hatred. He attacks each, and leaves with nothing gained.
visions.note: The story is dated only between 19 and 5 BBY; 12 BBY is a placeholder midpoint.

visions.title: Cal glimpses the High Republic on Koboh

legs.note: Touching Dagan's bacta tank, Cal sees the Nihil attack on Tanalorr and Dagan's past.
On the Shattered Moon he sees Santari Khri maim Dagan and seal him in bacta.

visions.summary: Psychometry on Koboh pulls Cal two centuries back: Santari Khri's droid, Dagan Gera's discovery of Tanalorr, the Nihil raid on it, and at last Santari cutting down her obsessed friend and sealing him in bacta, where Cal has just found him still alive.
visions.conflict: The Attack on Tanalorr is dated 232 BBY, yet Dagan Gera's article counts 224 years of stasis before 9 BBY (233 BBY), although he was sealed away after the attack.

visions.title: Obi-Wan's journal left for Luke

legs.note: Luke reads Ben's account of looking after him years before, among other stories from exile.

visions.summary: During his exile Obi-Wan kept a journal of his Tatooine years: quiet rescues, attempts to reach Qui-Gon, notes on lightsaber building. After Yavin, Luke recovers it from Ben's home, where it was left for him, and reads his guardian's stories.
visions.note: Entries span the whole exile; the first story told is dated 9 or 8 BBY.

visions.title: Ezra hears his parents in an old keycard

legs.note: A keycard in his old tower replays his parents with Tseebo, planning to resist the Empire.

visions.summary: On the Empire's anniversary, Ezra handles an old keycard and hears his mother and father talking with their friend Tseebo about resisting Imperial rule, years before they were taken. The echo tells him where Tseebo is hiding.
visions.note: Untrained psychometry; the parents were taken by 12 BBY, so the echo predates that.

visions.title: Ezra's visions lead him to his parents' fate

legs.note: A dream of his imprisoned parents, a pale Loth-cat and a battle on Garel starts the search.
After learning they died freeing prisoners, Ezra sees his parents once more; they are proud.

visions.summary: A dream shows Ezra his imprisoned parents, a pale Loth-cat and a battle on Garel. Following it to Lothal he finds Ryder Azadi, who says the Bridgers died so other prisoners could escape. That night his mother and father visit him in a vision, proud of their son.
visions.note: The second vision is of the dead, but sources treat it as a vision rather than a Force spirit.

visions.title: Ahsoka's vision of Anakin turns into Vader

legs.note: The vision confirms what happened when Anakin fell during the Order's destruction.

visions.summary: Meditating in the Lothal temple, Ahsoka hears Anakin ask why she left him and whether she understands what he turned into. His figure becomes Darth Vader's. She spins with a blade lit and finds nothing, but can no longer deny who Vader is.
visions.note: Reveals a past truth rather than a future.

visions.title: A temple guard's vision knights Kanan

legs.note: The Sentinel has the Grand Inquisitor's face, from the years he guarded the Jedi Temple.
The Sentinel warns Ezra may fall; Ezra reaches for dark power on Malachor that year.

visions.summary: Kanan duels a masked Temple Guard called the Sentinel, who says he cannot keep Ezra safe from darkness. When Kanan accepts that, the guard knights him and unmasks, revealing the Grand Inquisitor's face, the enemy Kanan killed, from the days before the Purge.
visions.note: The Grand Inquisitor died in 4 BBY; tying the warning to Malachor is interpretive.

visions.title: Yoda shows Ezra the Jedi at war

legs.note: Clones massing and Jedi in battle: Yoda's lesson on how fear drew the Order into war.
Yoda's last word, Malachor, sends the Jedi to the Sith world.

visions.summary: Speaking to Ezra from afar inside the Lothal temple, Yoda shows him clone armies and fighting Jedi and explains that fear led the Order into the war that undid it. Pressed for a way to beat Vader, he reluctantly names Malachor.

visions.title: Fused holocrons point Maul to Tatooine

legs.note: The joined Jedi and Sith holocrons show twin suns; Maul realizes Kenobi is alive.
A Nightsister spell completes the vision: a desert world under two suns.

visions.summary: Maul makes Ezra fuse his Jedi holocron with the Sith one, and the merged light shows each what he wants. Ezra pulls away, but Maul sees enough to know Kenobi lives. A Nightsister ritual finishes the picture, and Maul goes to Tatooine to die at Kenobi's hand.
visions.note: The holocron meeting takes place at a Mandalorian asteroid outpost, so no planet is given.

visions.title: Dying Maul foretells the Sith's end

legs.note: Maul trusts the Chosen One Kenobi guards will avenge them; Sidious dies at Endor.

visions.summary: Struck down by Obi-Wan in a single exchange, Maul asks if the old Jedi is protecting the Chosen One. Told yes, he says with his last breath that he will avenge them both. Six years later Luke's refusal to kill leads Anakin to destroy Sidious.
visions.note: Maul means Luke; that the vengeance comes through Anakin and Luke together is interpretive.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: The Bendu foresees Thrawn's cold embrace

legs.note: The 'many arms' are purrgil that seize the Chimaera above Lothal and carry Thrawn away.

visions.summary: Wounded after the fight on Atollon, the Bendu tells Thrawn he can see his defeat: many arms closing around him in an icy hold. Then he vanishes, laughing. A year later purrgil called by Ezra coil around the Chimaera and drag it into hyperspace.

visions.title: Kanan's will speaks through the wolf Dume

legs.note: In a dream, the white wolf bearing Kanan's birth name hands Ezra the temple's key stone.
Collapsing after the temple is sealed, Ezra hears Kanan's voice bless him one last time.

visions.summary: After Kanan dies saving his friends, a huge white Loth-wolf calling itself Dume, Kanan's birth name, finds Ezra and points him toward the temple to set the past right and save the future. Ahsoka later explains the wolf carries Kanan's will.
visions.note: Not a classic Force spirit: sources call Dume a manifestation of Kanan's will.

visions.title: Ezra hears echoes of past and future

legs.note: Past: Qui-Gon, Anakin, Yoda and the Mortis Father and Daughter; individual lines are not dated.
Present: Kanan Jarrus, plus Jyn Erso and Chirrut Îmwe, all living in Ezra's own year.
Future: Kylo Ren, Rey, Finn, Poe Dameron, Maz Kanata and Leia, all sequel-era speakers.

visions.summary: Drawn through the Lothal temple's painted gateway, Ezra crosses a starry void threaded with walkways and doors. Voices spill in from every age: Jedi from the Republic's last years, rebels of his own moment, heroes of battles decades away. It is the first sign the realm touches all times.
visions.note: The voices are archival film and series audio; eras are assigned by speaker, not by scene.

visions.title: Ezra pulls Ahsoka out of Malachor

legs.note: Through a doorway Ezra reaches the Malachor duel and hauls Ahsoka clear as Vader drops into the pit.
Ahsoka steps back through her own doorway into the Sith temple, alive, and walks into its depths.
Keeping her promise to find Ezra, she reappears on Lothal after the Empire's fall.

visions.summary: Following the convor Morai, Ezra finds a door opening onto Ahsoka's fight with Darth Vader two years earlier and drags her out before the fatal blow. After they escape Palpatine she goes back to that instant alive, which is how she can resurface years later.
visions.note: Twilight of the Apprentice shows the original duel; the Rebels epilogue is dated 9 ABY.

visions.title: Ezra watches Kanan's sacrifice through a doorway

legs.note: A doorway shows Kanan holding back the fuel-depot fireball; Ezra decides not to pull him out.

visions.summary: Having saved Ahsoka, Ezra wants to rescue his own master and finds the moment Kanan shields the rebels from the burning depot. Ahsoka warns that changing it would doom everyone Kanan saved. Ezra lets the moment stand and understands it as Kanan's last lesson.
visions.note: frac values only order Kanan's death (Jedi Night) before Ezra's visit within 1 BBY.

visions.title: Palpatine breaks into the realm between worlds

legs.note: From a ritual chamber on Coruscant, Sidious looks through Kanan's doorway and sends fire after them.

visions.summary: Working Sith sorcery far away on Coruscant, the Emperor forces an opening into the realm and tries to seize both Force users with blue flame. Ahsoka slashes it apart, the pair split for their own doors, and Ezra seals the Lothal gateway by bringing the temple down.

visions.title: The Emperor tempts Ezra with his parents

legs.note: A temple fragment rebuilt aboard the Chimaera opens on Mira and Ephraim calling their son home.

visions.summary: Aboard the Chimaera, a hologram of Palpatine shows Ezra a rebuilt piece of the Lothal temple and a gateway where his parents wait, promising he can undo the past. Ezra, who felt them die, tells them goodbye and tears the structure down.
visions.note: The gateway's destination is never dated; placing it before the parents' arrest is an inference.

visions.title: Ezra's farewell hologram outlives his disappearance

legs.note: Chopper plays it right after the Chimaera vanishes: Ezra had to go, and hopes to come home.
Sabine is still replaying it in her tower a decade later.
Ahsoka switches it on while searching Sabine's home for clues.

visions.summary: Before letting the purrgil carry him and Thrawn away, Ezra records a goodbye: he had to choose this path, he left fruit for Hera, and he is counting on Sabine. Years later she still watches it, alone in her Lothal tower.

visions.title: Leia's hidden plea reaches Obi-Wan

legs.note: Recorded into R2-D2 aboard the Tantive IV, it reaches Kenobi through Luke days later.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
visions.summary: As Vader's troops storm her ship, Leia records a plea into R2-D2 and sends him to Tatooine with the stolen plans. The droid shows a fragment to Luke, then the whole message to Obi-Wan, who answers the call and ends his exile.
visions.note: Spans days, not years; included as the saga's founding message across distance.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

visions.title: Obi-Wan's life flashes by as he dies

legs.note: Qui-Gon dying after the duel with Maul, and the funeral pyre that followed.
Newborn Luke in his arms as Padmé breathes her last.
Qui-Gon's voice wakes him to defend three-year-old Luke from raiders at the Lars farm.

visions.summary: As Vader's blade falls on the Death Star, Obi-Wan's mind races through his life: Qui-Gon's death, Luke's birth, early years watching the boy, a bandit raid he was warned of. Then his old master tells him to let his life go, and he passes into the Force.
sources: From a Certain Point of View
visions.conflict: Time of Death has Qui-Gon's voice guide Obi-Wan in 16 BBY; the Kenobi series shows no contact with Qui-Gon before 9 BBY. Author Cavan Scott (2026) was unsure whether it had been retconned.

visions.title: Obi-Wan's voice guides Luke at Yavin

legs.note: Just after dying, Obi-Wan tells Luke to run for the Falcon.
In the trench run he tells Luke to trust the Force; Luke switches off his targeting computer.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
visions.summary: Struck down by Vader, Obi-Wan vanishes, and at once his voice tells Luke to run. Over Yavin it speaks again, urging Luke to lean on the Force; he shuts off his targeting computer and destroys the Death Star.
visions.note: The updated Galactic Atlas puts this film's pre-battle events in 1 BBY, placing the battle itself at year 0.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

visions.title: Obi-Wan's spirit sends Luke to Yoda

legs.note: Freezing in the snow, Luke sees Obi-Wan and is told to go find Yoda on Dagobah.
Obi-Wan appears beside Yoda to warn Luke not to abandon his training.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back
visions.summary: Years after his death, Obi-Wan's shimmering figure finds Luke dying of cold on Hoth and sends him to Dagobah to learn from Yoda. Later, as a spirit beside Yoda, he pleads with Luke not to rush to Bespin; Luke goes anyway.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

visions.title: Obi-Wan's spirit tells Luke of his sister

legs.note: After Yoda's death, Obi-Wan explains Anakin's fall and confirms Leia is Luke's twin.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
visions.summary: Moments after Yoda dies and vanishes, Obi-Wan appears on Dagobah to face Luke's anger: Vader really is his father, and Obi-Wan's earlier words were only half the truth. He adds that Luke's twin sister is Leia, and that Luke must confront Vader again.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: Obi-Wan, Yoda and Anakin appear at Endor

legs.note: Obi-Wan, dead for five years.
Yoda, dead since shortly before the battle.
Anakin, redeemed and dead only hours, kept whole by his old masters' teaching.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
visions.summary: As the rebels celebrate on the forest moon, Luke looks up to see three shining figures watching him: Obi-Wan, Yoda and, restored to his younger self, Anakin Skywalker, redeemed, who perished on the battle station that day.
visions.note: Canon says Obi-Wan and Yoda preserved Anakin's identity, since he never learned the skill.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: Luke meets himself behind Vader's mask

legs.note: The warning plays out aboard Palpatine's new battle station, where Luke's rage nearly makes him his father.

visions.record: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back
visions.summary: Sent into a dark cave on Dagobah, Luke meets a phantom Darth Vader, strikes its head off and sees his own face inside the cracked helmet. The image warns of the darkness in him, which surfaces the next year as he hacks off Vader's hand in fury.
visions.note: Tying the vision to Luke's near-fall at Endor is interpretive; the film does not say so.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back
Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

visions.title: Luke sees his friends suffering in Cloud City
